title: Virtual Assistant — Operations, QA & Social Media Support
description:
Remote | Part-Time | Ongoing Contractor Role



Hi! I'm Katherine, a systems and operations consultant looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to work directly with me and support several ongoing client projects.



This role will start at approximately 8–12 hours per week, with the potential to grow toward 15–20 hours per week as my business and workload grow.



What You'll Help With

Quality Assurance (QA): Reviewing information, catching errors, and following established processes

Admin & Operations: Updating records, organizing information, preparing documents, and keeping systems current

Phone &
 Follow-Up: Making professional calls using provided scripts, following up, and documenting results

Canva & Social Media: Creating graphics using existing branding/templates and assisting with social content

Research & Data Entry: Finding, verifying, and accurately organizing information



You Might Be a Great Fit If You:

Are detail-oriented, reliable, and organized

Communicate clearly and professionally in English

Are comfortable making professional phone calls

Have experience with Canva and basic social media content

Can follow written/video SOPs and learn new systems

Can work independently and ask questions when something isn't clear

Have reliable high-speed internet, a computer/laptop, and a quiet space for calls



Experience with ClickUp, Dubsado, Canva, CRM/database management, QA, or administrative support is a plus, but you don't need to know every system already.



Grow With Me:  I'm actively growing my business and would love to find someone who is excited to grow alongside it. Hours may be lighter initially as you're onboarded and take over responsibilities. As I bring on more work and delegate more, there's potential for your hours and responsibilities to increase as well.



While I can't guarantee future hours, my goal is to build a long-term working relationship with someone who can become an important part of how I operate. You'll receive clear SOPs, training, direct communication with me, and increasing independence as you learn the role.

We welcome fresh graduates who are eager to build a career in the U.S. mortgage industry. Candidates with mortgage funding, closing, post-closing, processing, setup, underwriting support, or related mortgage experience are highly encouraged to apply.



This position offers an excellent opportunity to learn the U.S. mortgage process, work directly with mortgage professionals, and develop valuable industry skills while working from home.



RESPONSIBILITIES

> Review loan documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance

> Verify that all funding conditions have been satisfied before loan disbursement

> Coordinate with title companies, escrow officers, processors, and underwriters

> Process funding requests and maintain funding records

> Review loan files and identify missing or incorrect documentation

> Perform quality control reviews prior to funding

> Maintain organized loan records and documentation

> Communicate funding requirements and issues to appropriate parties

> Follow company policies, investor guidelines, and regulatory requirements

> Participate in ongoing training and process improvement initiatives



QUALIFICATIONS



> Fresh graduates are welcome to apply

> Previous mortgage experience is preferred but not required

> Experience in mortgage funding, closing, post-closing, processing, setup, underwriting support, or related roles is an advantage

> Strong attention to detail and accuracy

> Excellent organizational and time management skills

> Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

> Ability to work independently and manage deadlines

> Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

> Experience with mortgage software or loan origination systems is a plus



WORK-FROM-HOME REQUIREMENTS



> Windows-based laptop or desktop computer

> Minimum 8GB RAM (16GB preferred)

> Reliable high-speed internet connection

> Backup internet connection preferred

> Quiet and professional work environment

> Dual-monitor setup is an advantage

> Willing to install company-required software and monitoring tools



WHAT WE OFFER



> Competitive salary based on experience

> Comprehensive training and exposure to U.S. mortgage operations

> Long-term career growth opportunities

> Work-from-home setup

> Supportive and professional team environment

> Performance and salary reviews based on performance and tenure



HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: To show that you have read this job post carefully, start your application with:

"I have read the job post from beginning to end."



Please send the following:

> Resume using a Google Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox link with viewing access enabled

> Brief cover letter explaining why you are interested in the position

> Screenshot of your internet speed test

> Computer specifications (Processor, RAM, and Operating System)



Applications that do not follow the instructions above may not be considered.



We look forward to meeting motivated individuals who are ready to build a long-term career in the U.S. mortgage industry.

title: Senior Non-QM Mortgage Underwriter (Remote | Night Shift)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

Senior Non-QM Mortgage Underwriter (Remote | Night Shift)

Php 70,000 – Php 188,179/month (based on experience)

Full-Time | Permanent Remote | U.S. Mortgage Company



>Why This Role is Different



We’re not looking for a basic underwriter.



We’re hiring someone who can confidently review and approve complex Non-QM loans — someone who understands risk, moves fast, and knows how to make solid credit decisions.



If you have strong Non-QM experience and want to work directly with a growing U.S.-based mortgage team, this is a long-term opportunity with real impact.



> What You’ll Be Doing



Underwrite Non-QM loans (DSCR, Bank Statement, WVOE, P&L)



Analyze credit, income, assets, and collateral



Review AUS findings and apply conditions or overlays



Issue decisions: Approve, Deny, or Suspend



Work closely with processors and operations to clear conditions



Maintain strong turn times while ensuring compliance



Support junior team members when needed



> What We’re Looking For



At least 5 years U.S. mortgage underwriting experience



Strong Non-QM experience (DSCR, Bank Statement, etc.)



Experience handling self-employed borrowers and complex files



Solid understanding of U.S. mortgage guidelines (TRID, ATR/QM, etc.)



Able to make independent credit decisions



Detail-oriented and reliable in a remote setup



Plus (but not required):



Experience with Encompass



Korean, Chinese, or Vietnamese language skills



> Work Setup



Remote (Work from Home)



Night Shift: 11:30 PM – 8:30 AM PH Time



Stable, long-term role with a U.S.-based company



> Basic Requirements



At least 16GB RAM



Intel i5 (4th gen or newer) or equivalent



Stable internet (minimum 100 Mbps)



>> How to Apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and follow the instructions below carefully:



1. All applicants must submit their application via
 sent directly through OnlineJobs.ph.

Applications sent outside of OnlineJobs.ph will not be considered.

Updated Resume (PDF or link — Google Drive/Dropbox/OLJ profile)

If submitting a link, make sure it is set to “Anyone with the link can view”



Years of U.S. Mortgage Underwriting Experience



Years of Non-QM Experience (DSCR, Bank Statement, etc.)



Expected Monthly Salary (PHP)



Earliest Start Date / Availability



2. Answer This Question (Required)



In your application message, briefly answer:



What are the three main documents you review when underwriting a DSCR loan?



(Keep your answer short and direct.)



3. Important



To confirm you have read the job post, please include this line at the beginning of your message:



“I have Non-QM underwriting experience.”



4. For Shortlisted Candidates Only



If you are shortlisted, you will be asked to complete a quick follow-up step, which includes:



Internet speed test (screenshot from speedtest.net)



Computer specifications (RAM and processor)



Short Non-QM scenario-based questions



>> Note



Only applicants who follow the instructions above will be prioritized for review.



>> Shortlisted Candidates



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a short screening step, which may include:



Quick technical questions (Non-QM / DSCR)



Speedtest and computer specs



Brief experience validation



>> Final Note



We’re looking for serious underwriters who know how to assess risk and make confident decisions.



If that’s you, apply now — we review applications daily.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP!!



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other team members can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Golf Video Editor | YouTube, Shot Tracers & Motion Graphics
description:
Long Term Golf Video Editor



We’re looking for an experienced GOLF video editor to join our team long term.



This position is specifically for someone who understands golf content and knows how to turn on course footage into polished, engaging YouTube videos and short form content.



This is not a basic social media editing position.



We need someone who understands golf, storytelling, pacing, shot tracers, score graphics, motion graphics, sound design, and cinematic editing.



Editing Style



You should be familiar with content from:



* Bryson DeChambeau

* Grant Horvat

* Adventures in Golf / Erik Anders Lang

* Skratch

* No Laying Up

* Peter Finch

* Rick Shiels



Our content can move between two different styles.



On Course Golf Content



Think Bryson DeChambeau or Grant Horvat.



* Golf matches and challenges

* Playing famous courses

* Hole by hole storytelling

* Shot tracers

* Yardages

* Club selections

* Score graphics

* Hole information

* Reactions

* Golf specific sound design

* Drone footage

* B Roll between shots



Cinematic Golf Films



Think Adventures in Golf, Skratch, and No Laying Up.



These videos focus more on:



* The golf course

* Course history

* Travel

* Architecture

* The overall experience

* Cinematic B Roll

* Drone footage

* Natural sound

* Music

* Storytelling

* Interviews and talking heads



You need to understand when a video should feel energetic and when the footage needs room to breathe.



Golf Editing Experience



Golf editing experience is strongly preferred.



You should understand the natural flow of a golf video without needing every edit explained to you.



For example:



Tee shot ? tracer ? reaction ? second shot ? course B Roll ? approach ? putt ? score update ? next hole.



You should understand basic golf terminology and what viewers care about during a round.



Actually playing golf is a major plus.



Shot Tracers



This is extremely important.



You must be able to create professional looking:



* Ball tracers

* Shot tracers

* Curved shot shapes

* Drives

* Approach shot tracers

* Drone shot tracers when appropriate



The tracer needs to accurately follow the golf ball and shot shape.



We do not want random lines drawn into the sky.



Please provide examples of golf tracers you have personally created.



Golf Motion Graphics



You should be capable of creating clean, modern golf graphics such as:



* Hole number

* Par

* Yardage

* Player score

* Current score to par

* Club selection

* Shot distance

* Carry distance

* Pin location

* Hole maps

* Course maps

* Leaderboards

* Scorecards

* Lower thirds

* Animated typography

* Simple course information graphics



Think professional golf broadcast graphics mixed with modern YouTube golf content.



Nothing cheesy, outdated, or unnecessarily flashy.



Storytelling



We do not want someone who simply cuts clips together.



You should be able to watch footage and recognize:



“This shot needs more buildup.”



“This reaction should stay in.”



“We need B Roll here.”



“This hole is dragging.”



“This drone shot would establish the next hole.”



“This music doesn’t match the scene.”



“This moment needs natural sound instead of music.”



You should be helping build the story, not waiting for instructions on every cut.



Sound Design



Sound design is extremely important.



You should know how to use:



* Golf ball impacts

* Club sounds

* Natural course ambience

* Birds and wind

* Crowd reactions when applicable

* Dialogue

* Subtle risers

* Transitions

* Music

* Sound effects



The goal is immersion, not adding a sound effect every three seconds.



Cinematic Editing



We shoot high quality footage including:



* Sony cameras

* Sony S Log3

* DJI drones

* Multiple camera angles

* Slow motion

* Course B Roll

* Talking heads

* On course audio



You should know how to combine these into a polished golf film.



Color grading experience with Sony S Log3 and DJI footage is a major plus.



We prefer natural, premium looking color instead of aggressive LUTs.



Types of Content



Projects may include:



* Golf course documentaries

* Playing famous golf courses

* Golf challenges

* On course matches

* Course reviews

* Golf travel films

* Golf resort videos

* Equipment testing

* Golf product reviews

* Brand campaigns

* YouTube videos

* Reels

* Shorts

* TikToks



Most importantly, you need to understand golf content.



What We’re Looking For



We want someone who:



* Has professional video editing experience

* Understands golf

* Can create accurate shot tracers

* Can create golf specific motion graphics

* Understands long form YouTube storytelling

* Understands cinematic pacing

* Has strong sound design skills

* Can work with drone footage

* Can organize large amounts of footage

* Pays attention to small details

* Can take feedback without needing every change explained

* Wants consistent long term editing work



Portfolio Requirements



Please send your best relevant examples, especially:



1. Golf videos you have edited

2. Videos containing golf shot tracers

3. Golf motion graphics or score graphics

4. Long form YouTube videos

5. Cinematic or documentary style work



Do not send 20 random editing examples.



We would rather see 3 excellent, relevant projects than a large generic portfolio.



If you have never edited golf content, be upfront about it.



Application Instructions



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words:



“Grand Geneva”



If your application does not start with Grand Geneva, it will not be reviewed.



Then answer:



1. Link your portfolio.

2. Send your best golf video edit.

3. Send an example of a golf shot tracer you created.

4. What golf creators have you edited for, if any?

5. Do you personally play or follow golf?

6. What editing software do you use?

7. What software or method do you use for shot tracers?

8. Are you experienced with After Effects or similar motion graphics software?

9. How many years have you been editing?

10. How many hours are you available each week?

11. What is your expected hourly rate?

12. Which golf creator or golf channel best represents your editing style and why?



Skills Required



* Video Editing

* Golf Video Editing

* YouTube Video Editing

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

title: Client & Marketing Operations Coordinator (WordPress, SEO, GoHighLevel)
description:
Client & Marketing Operations Coordinator (WordPress, SEO, GoHighLevel)

Client support, membership site, publishing operations, and SEO



Full-time | Remote (Philippines) | Permanent | Semi-flexible schedule



ABOUT US



We are a small remote North American company providing online education and coaching programs. We run a YouTube channel with over 400k subscribers, deliver live events, maintain a client membership site, and publish written content on an ongoing schedule. Our team is long-tenured. This is an in-house seat: one company, one stack, permanent, not agency or client-rotation work.



THE ROLE



You keep two things running: our clients' experience of working with us, and the systems underneath it. Our website, funnels, calendar, and automations stay accurate underneath it all, and our search optimization work moves forward every week.



On the client side, logistical questions get answered the same business day, sessions get booked and rescheduled without friction, and the recordings and materials our clients paid for reach them when they expect them. When something needs judgment rather than logistics, you route it to the right person rather than guessing.



On the publishing side, our marketing content goes out on schedule: social posts loaded and verified live,
s scheduled and sent, articles published to the websites. Whatever our team and outside partners produce, you get it out correctly and confirm it landed. Our website, funnels, calendar, and automations stay accurate underneath it all, and our search optimization work moves forward every week.



Creative and build work is produced by our senior team and outside partners. Your work starts where theirs ends.



Day to day, you will:

• Resolve client logistics in our support inbox: scheduling, session links, reschedules, sending recordings, and access issues, using our documented reply guides

• Escalate anything that calls for judgment rather than logistics, routed to the right person on our team using our documented rules

• Manage our session and events calendar end to end: booking, rescheduling, cancelling, and rebooking through our approved process

• Administer our client membership site: recording uploads, content updates, member access, and setup for each new session

• Onboard and offboard clients to our checklist: access, calendar, and enrollment set up correctly at the start, and closed out cleanly at the end

• Load our weekly social publishing schedule from prepared asset packages across our platforms, write captions from our documented guides, and verify daily that every post actually published

• Assemble and send our weekly client
 and announcements from finished drafts, and load approved campaign sequences in GoHighLevel, verifying every send before it goes out

• Publish finished articles to WordPress and to our external article publishing platforms, applying our SEO specification to every website post and confirming it renders correctly

• Receive deliverables from our outside partners, check them against spec, and queue them

• Execute our SEO update plan across the existing site and content, to a written specification

• Make small updates to existing GoHighLevel pages, load approved
 sequences and broadcasts, and improve existing automations alongside our operations manager

• Monitor automation alerts, run first diagnosis, and escalate with a written report

• Collect weekly performance metrics across our platforms and prepare them for reporting



What success looks like in 90 days.

• Client logistics resolved same business day

• Every scheduled post verified as published, with any failure reported by you before anyone else notices

• The membership site current within 1 business day of any release

• Client
s and weekly articles out on schedule, every week

• The SEO update specification executed at 25 URLs per month



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



There are no full funnel builds, no graphic design, no video editing, no long-form copywriting, and no sales. Marketing content arrives already written. You load, format, send, and verify. Social media here means scheduling and verification, not content creation. If you are looking for a pure development seat or a creative seat, this is not it. The technical lane in this role is real, and it grows out of operations excellence.



WHO YOU ARE



• A technical foundation: a computer science, engineering, or related technical degree, or equivalent professional or self-taught depth. We can train depth in WordPress, GoHighLevel, and our other tools on the job, so specific tool experience is not required. Picking up new technical systems quickly, from documentation, is. Shown one worked example, you can produce the next twenty without constantly checking in.  

• An improvement habit. You understand tech and tools well enough to see where a process is weak, and you propose the fix rather than working around it. 

• Professional written English. Your writing goes to clients.

• Precision on repetitive, structured work. You follow checklists exactly, and you flag when a checklist is wrong.

• A verification habit. You confirm your output is live and you log it. "Scheduled" and "published" are different states to you.

• Proactive written communication. Blockers, anomalies, and your own mistakes surface early, from you. If you need to be chased, this will not be a good fit.



GROWTH



Promotion here follows demonstrated strength, and we have promoted from within before. Consistent precision in the core work earns expanded technical scope: building new automation workflows and pages under review, rather than only maintaining and optimizing existing ones.



COMPENSATION AND TERMS



$650 USD per month. Full-time and exclusive: we ask that this be your only professional commitment, and any current freelance clients or part-time work must be disclosed in your application. Semi-flexible schedule with 4 hours of overlap with North American Pacific business hours. Daily and weekly verification checkpoints are fixed.



APPLICATION PROCESS



1) Application review; 2) a live video interview with your camera on (no exceptions); 3) a paid trial task, 4) and a final interview. Identity and reference verification are completed before any offer.



TO APPLY



Send your CV with the subject line exactly: Application: Operations Coordinator (Verified)



In your message, answer these four questions:



1. Describe a process you ran for months without errors, and how you tracked that it stayed error-free.

2. Describe a mistake you caught that nobody else had noticed. What did you do next?

3. Describe something technical you taught yourself from documentation. What did you build or fix with it, and what part of the documentation was wrong or missing?

4. What does an ideal work week look like for you? 



Applications that do not follow these instructions are not reviewed.

title: Project & Operations Manager
description:
Role:

Project & Operations Manager.



Starting Salary:

$1,500 to $2,000 USD / month, based on experience.

Annual raises, promotions, and bonuses available.



Schedule:

Flexible, with a preference for an evening Philippine schedule that provides several hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time. Our current team works 5PM to 1AM Philippine Standard Time; however, we are open to modifying this schedule for the right candidate based on your preferred and current schedule.



Required Experience:

PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification — OR proven comparable experience managing projects, workflows, systems, or recurring operational processes in a current or recently held role — is required.



------------



Core Responsibilities:



1. Client Reporting & Data Organization:

You will be responsible for creating monthly reporting packages for our clients. This includes pulling data from multiple advertising platforms, organizing the data into reports, double-checking for accuracy, and delivering polished reporting to clients according to a defined schedule. Training will be provided. Extreme attention to detail is required.



2. Project & Task Coordination:

You will coordinate and manage ongoing projects, assignments, deadlines, and deliverables across our team. This includes keeping projects organized, following up on outstanding items, communicating status updates, and helping ensure work moves forward and deadlines are met. You should be comfortable proactively following up with team members, clients, and partners when something is needed to keep a project moving.



3. Recurring Operational Tasks:

You will oversee and execute a variety of weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual operational tasks. These include recurring client processes that must be completed consistently, accurately, and on time. You will be responsible for keeping track of these responsibilities and ensuring important tasks and deadlines do not fall through the cracks.



4. Client Communication, Website & Campaign Coordination:

You will manage operational workflows related to client website updates, seasonal changes, and campaign enrollments. This includes proactively reaching out to clients for information such as holiday hours, submitting required forms for campaign participation, following up when information is outstanding, and coordinating updates with website partners when needed.



5. Process Adherence & Improvement:

As you become familiar with our operations, we encourage you to identify opportunities to improve existing workflows or recommend new ones when appropriate. You will also help document new and updated systems and workflows. Interest in tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Zendesk, or similar platforms is a bonus, but not required.



6. Documentation:

Create clear written Slab documentation and Loom screen recordings for processes and workflows. Documentation should be organized, easy for other team members to follow, and updated when processes change.



------------



Who We're Looking For:



* PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification — or proven comparable experience managing projects, workflows, systems, or recurring operational processes in a current or recently held role — is required.



* Experience with project management and coordination, operations, reporting, client communication, or a similar role.



* Proficiency in Loom, Zoom, Slack, Slab, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.



* You are extremely detail-oriented and methodical.



* You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple recurring responsibilities, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.



* You are steady, reliable, and consistent in your output.



* You enjoy structured, repeatable work and clear processes.



* You take ownership of your responsibilities and make sure important tasks and deadlines don't fall through the cracks.

* You communicate clearly and proactively when something is unclear or missing, when you need assistance, or simply to provide updates.



* You are comfortable communicating professionally with clients via
 and other written channels.



* Your English, both written and verbal, is strong and professional.



* You double-check your work and take accuracy seriously.



* You work well remotely and independently without requiring constant oversight.



* You have a dedicated, quiet, professional home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.



* Bachelor's or Master's Degree.



* ID Proof of 90 or higher & Government ID Verified.



* OnlineJobs.PH profile must include IQ, DISC & English Proficiency scores.



------------



Benefits:



* Competitive compensation

* 13th month pay

* All major Filipino holidays off

* Select U.S. holidays off

* Paid vacation / PTO

* Annual raises

* Promotion and growth opportunities

* Long-term, stable employment

* Flexible work schedule

* Primarily Slack-based communication

* Work alongside fellow Filipino specialists



------------

This is a long-term, stable career opportunity designed for someone who values consistency, reliability, organization, ownership, and attention to detail. The role is built around client reporting, project coordination, recurring operational responsibilities, and clear systems.



You'll be trusted to independently manage your responsibilities, proactively communicate when something needs attention, and ensure important deadlines and deliverables don't fall through the cracks. We're looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of important responsibilities while working within established systems and processes.

Benefits for full-time team members include a competitive base salary, 13th month pay, Filipino & U.S. paid holidays, PTO (paid time off), annual raises, promotion opportunities, and more.

At the same time, this is an important role with real ownership and accountability. We value team members who can be trusted to stay organized, communicate proactively, follow through on commitments, and consistently produce accurate work.



If you enjoy taking ownership of important responsibilities, keeping projects and processes organized, working within clear systems, and collaborating with other talented Filipino specialists, this could be a great long-term fit.



------------

To apply, you must reply to this job posting from within OnlineJobs.PH with a link to a newly-created video application.

MUST HAVE

AI EXPERIENCE

Build AI-assisted workflows inside or alongside GoHighLevel

Work with AI chat/SMS agents and automated lead follow-up

Experience with Meta Lead Ads and

Experience with Vercel, GitHub, or modern SaaS infrastructure

Experience in dental, healthcare, medspa, or local-service businesses

Experience supporting a SaaS product

Familiarity with HIPAA-conscious workflows and healthcare environments



You should be fast, resourceful, highly technical, and comfortable figuring things out independently.



We don't want someone who needs a step-by-step SOP for every problem.



We're looking for someone who can receive an issue like:



"Leads are entering GHL but the AI isn't texting them."



…and independently investigate the contact, workflow, triggers, phone configuration, messaging status, integrations, and logs until they find the root cause.



You should be comfortable receiving direct feedback and taking full ownership of technical problems from investigation through resolution.



What you'll get:

$1,500/month base + up to $250/month performance bonus

100% remote work

Work from anywhere

Hands-on experience with hundreds of live GoHighLevel accounts

Exposure to AI agents, automation systems, APIs, SaaS infrastructure, and real-world technical problems

Significant ownership over technical operations

Opportunity to build systems that directly impact hundreds of businesses

Front-row seat to a fast-scaling SaaS company

If you enjoy opening GoHighLevel, finding a broken automation, figuring out why it broke, fixing it, testing it, and then finding a way to prevent the same issue from happening across another 300 accounts — this role is for you.

title: Meta and Google Ads Media Buyer for US Home Services Lead Generation
description:
We are a US marketing agency. We run Meta ads and booking systems for outdoor

lighting companies across the United States. Our job is simple to describe and

hard to do well. We get a homeowner to raise their hand, then we get that

homeowner onto the client's calendar for an estimate.



We need a media buyer who has run LOCAL LEAD GENERATION, not ecommerce. There

is no shopping cart here. Success is a booked estimate the client actually

shows up to. If you have only run purchase campaigns for dropshipping stores,

this role will frustrate you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build and launch Meta campaigns for client accounts (lead forms and landing

  page conversions)

- Check every account every morning. Catch dead ads, spend spikes, rejected

  creative, and broken forms before the client does

- Run the creative testing calendar with our video editor. New angles in,

  losers off, winners scaled

- Watch lead quality, not just cost per lead. Bad leads at a good price are a

  failure

- Keep the daily scorecard current so we always know cost per lead and cost per

  booked appointment by account

- Send one written weekly report per client account with what changed, what it

  cost, and what is next

- Manage pixels, conversion events, audiences, and exclusions across accounts

- Build our playbook. In your first 60 days you will turn our screen recordings

  and your own daily work into written SOPs in Notion, with screenshots. We

  give you the hours for this. It is a real part of the job, not extra credit



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



- You will not talk to clients. Our founder owns every client relationship

- You will not set strategy alone for the first 90 days. Offer, angle,

  geography, and budget calls come from our founder. You own the build, the

  daily execution, and the recommendations

- You will not touch client money. Clients pay Meta directly on their own cards



WHAT YOU NEED



- 2 or more years buying Meta ads with real budget responsibility. Tell me the

  monthly spend you personally managed

- Direct experience with local service lead generation in the US. Home services

  is ideal

- You can explain the difference between an instant form lead and a landing

  page lead, and when you would use each

- You know how to set up the pixel and conversion events, and you can tell when

  tracking is lying to you

- You are comfortable working accounts in the $50 to $200 per day range. This

  is not a $10k per day ecom job

- Good written English. You will write client-facing reports our founder

  reviews and sends

- You can work 9am to 1pm US Eastern every weekday. Accounts break in the

  morning and we fix them in the morning



NICE TO HAVE



- Google Ads or Local Services Ads experience

- You have worked inside GoHighLevel or a similar CRM and understand what

  happens to a lead after the form

- You have run multiple client accounts at once at an agency

- You have opinions about creative and can brief an editor properly

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Advanced Slack skills

WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field, write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: CS Retention Manager – $2,000 Base p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Credit Repair Specialist – Personal & Business Credit (US)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Repair Specialist who can handle both personal and business credit for our US-based clients. This is a long-term role that requires deep knowledge of the full credit repair and credit-building process — from disputing negative items on personal reports all the way through establishing and scaling business credit.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Analyzing personal credit reports (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion) and identifying negative, inaccurate, or disputable items

- Drafting and sending dispute letters to bureaus, creditors, and collection agencies (goodwill letters, debt validation letters, 609/611 letters, CFPB complaints)

- Guiding clients through the process of rebuilding personal credit scores

- Transitioning clients from repaired personal credit to building strong business credit profiles (Dun & Bradstreet, Experian Business, Equifax Business)

- Setting up business credit foundations: EIN, business address, phone, DUNS/PAYDEX score, vendor tradelines, net-30 accounts, business credit cards

- Monitoring credit report progress and adjusting strategy as needed

- Keeping accurate records and updating clients on their progress



Who We're Looking For:

- Proven experience in US personal credit repair (must know FCRA, FDCPA, and dispute processes inside and out)

- Strong knowledge of business credit building — not just personal

- Understands the full pathway: repair personal ? establish business entity ? build business credit profile ? access business funding

- Knows which net-30 vendors, tradelines, and business credit cards to use at each stage

- Familiar with credit repair software platforms (DisputeBee, Credit Repair Cloud, ScoreCEO, DisputeFox, or similar)

- Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple client files simultaneously



Schedule: Part-time to start, with potential to grow into full-time. Must have availability during US business hours (Mountain Time preferred).



Please answer all 5 screening questions below in your application — applications without answers will not be reviewed.



Screening Questions:

1. A client has a collection account on their personal credit report that is 3 years old. The collection agency is reporting inaccurate information. Walk us through exactly what steps you would take and which letters you would send, and in what order.



2. After a client's personal credit score improves, what are the first 5 concrete steps you take to start building their business credit from scratch? Please be specific — what entities do you register with, in what order, and why?



3. What is a PAYDEX score, how is it calculated, and what are the best strategies to get a business to a PAYDEX score of 80 or higher as quickly as possible?



4. A client has a personal credit score of 620 and no business credit history. They want to qualify for business funding in 12 months. What is your month-by-month strategy to get them there?



5. What credit repair software do you prefer to use and why? What specific features does it have that make your work faster or more effective? Have you used any AI tools to assist with the dispute or credit-building process?



Compensation: DOE — please include your desired hourly rate in your application.

We operate multiple septic trucks and complete interesting, messy and highly visual jobs every day. We have more than 250 five-star Google reviews and want to become the most recognizable septic company in Texas.

Customer testimonials

Funny technician moments

Septic myths and facts

title: Business Development & Customer Success Representative
description:
No problem — here's a clean, copy-paste-ready version you can paste directly into a platform:



Business Development & Customer Success Representative



Location: Philippines (Remote)

Type: Full-time

Reports to: CMO, Australia

Market: Australia & New Zealand

Industry: Cybersecurity | SaaS | Technology



About the Role

Cybersecurity is one of the most important challenges facing businesses today. At Tautsec, we're building an ambitious Australian cybersecurity company with a simple goal: help businesses become more secure, resilient and better prepared for the threats they face.



We're looking for a Business Development & Customer Success Representative, based in the Philippines, to own the full front-end of the customer journey — from the very first conversation with a prospect, through to helping them get fully set up and confident using CyberPilot, our platform, once they've signed on.



This is a dual-focus role for someone who wants to build relationships, not just book meetings — equally comfortable opening a new conversation with a prospect and making sure an existing customer feels genuinely looked after.



The Role

Your mission has two halves. On the front end, you'll create high-quality sales conversations and build qualified pipeline for our commercial team — through your own outbound research as well as by qualifying inbound leads from our marketing, events and tradeshow activity. On the back end, once a deal closes, you'll take ownership of onboarding — making sure new customers are set up, scheduled, trained and confident using CyberPilot from day one.



You'll work across multiple channels —
, phone, LinkedIn, video calls and CyberPilot itself — and you'll be one of the few people at Tautsec with visibility across the entire customer lifecycle: from first hello to fully onboarded.



Part One: Business Development

Create the conversations that build our pipeline — across both outbound and inbound.



Outbound: you'll do your own research and proactively go find opportunities.



Research target companies across ANZ and identify where cybersecurity is a genuine business priority.

Build and maintain high-quality prospect lists and identify key decision-makers.

Run confident outbound calls, personalised
 campaigns and LinkedIn outreach.

Ask thoughtful discovery questions to understand a prospect's priorities, risks and buying triggers.



Inbound: you'll follow up and qualify leads generated by our marketing engine.



Respond quickly to leads generated through digital marketing campaigns, webinars, events and tradeshows.

Qualify inbound interest with the same rigour as outbound — understanding real intent, timing and fit before it goes to the sales team.

Work closely with marketing to understand campaign context, so your follow-up feels informed, not generic.



Across both channels, your job is the same: qualify opportunities and hand the sales team clear context — not just a booking.



Support outbound campaigns, ABM initiatives, webinars and demand-gen programs.



Part Two: Customer Success & Onboarding

Once a customer signs, you become their trusted guide to getting real value from CyberPilot — and their advocate inside Tautsec.



Own the handover from sales to onboarding, and be the new customer's first point of contact after they sign.

Schedule and run structured onboarding calls, walking customers through setup and getting them fully live on CyberPilot.

Build a simple success plan for each new customer — clear onboarding milestones, timelines and what "live and confident" looks like for them.

Become a product SME on CyberPilot's core features, so you can answer setup and usage questions confidently without always escalating.

Run proactive check-ins and light-touch health checks during the first 30–90 days to confirm the customer is actually using CyberPilot, not just signed up to it.

Coordinate onboarding timelines and keep customers, and internal teams, on track to go-live.

Troubleshoot basic setup issues, and know when to loop in technical or support teams for anything more complex.

Flag early risk signals — low engagement, confusion, unmet expectations — to the commercial team before they become churn or renewal risk.

Be the voice of the customer internally — feed onboarding feedback and common questions back to the team to improve our onboarding materials, playbooks and even the product itself.

Spot early expansion or upsell signals during onboarding conversations and pass them to the commercial team.



You don't need to be a cybersecurity expert or a technical implementation specialist when you join us — you do need to be organised, empathetic, and genuinely motivated by seeing a customer succeed, not just sign.



What You'll Bring



Essential



3–5+ years' experience in a B2B customer-facing role — sales, business development, customer success, account management or onboarding — ideally within SaaS or technology.

A demonstrated track record of hitting targets or KPIs in a previous sales or customer success role, with results you can speak to.

Strong written and spoken English, and confidence engaging both prospects and existing customers, including senior stakeholders.

Comfortable switching between two mindsets: proactive outbound sales, and patient, structured customer support.

Excellent organisation — you can juggle a pipeline of prospects and a caseload of onboarding customers without dropping either.

Able to work independently with a remote Australian team, during Australian business hours.



Highly Desirable



Experience selling or supporting cybersecurity products specifically, ideally into Australia or another international market.

Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or a CRM/customer success platform.

Experience running onboarding, training, implementation calls or health-check reviews with customers.

Understanding of B2B technology buying and basic cybersecurity concepts.



This is a role for someone who already knows how to do this well and wants real ownership — not a training-ground position. If you bring the experience and can show us the results to back it up, we want to hear from you.



The Tautsec Standard

You don't need to tick every box, but these qualities matter: driven, resilient, curious, coachable, commercially minded, confident without ego, disciplined, resourceful, and competitive but collaborative. We're building a high-performing team that shares knowledge and helps each other improve.



AI & Modern Sales

The best BDRs of the future combine human connection with intelligent technology. You'll be encouraged to use AI to research accounts, prepare for conversations, personalise outreach and improve productivity — as a tool to sharpen judgement, not replace it.



Your First 90 Days

Days 1–30 (Orient): Get up to speed on Tautsec, CyberPilot, our customers and sales process; start prospecting and taking inbound leads within your first couple of weeks, not after a long ramp.



Days 30–60 (Deliver): Own your full pipeline and onboarding caseload independently, applying the experience you already bring rather than still learning the basics.



Days 60–90 (Optimise): Be operating at full capacity across both sides of the role, and bringing your own ideas to improve how we prospect, qualify and onboard.



How We'll Measure Success



Business development: qualified meetings and opportunities generated, pipeline contribution, outbound campaign performance.

Customer success: onboarding completion rate and time-to-value, customer engagement in the first 90 days, onboarding satisfaction.



Numbers aren't the whole story — we'll also look at the quality of your conversations on both sides, how quickly you learn, and the value you bring to the team.



Why Join Tautsec?

This is a chance to join early — working directly with Australian leadership, with visibility across the entire customer journey and real influence over how we build our sales and customer experience engine, in one of the world's most important technology sectors.



Work remotely from the Philippines with senior AU marketing and commercial leadership.

Build rare, end-to-end experience spanning sales and customer success.

Develop deep expertise in cybersecurity and B2B technology, with ongoing coaching.

Grow into senior commercial or customer success leadership as we scale.



Your growth is part of our growth.

title: Remote Bookkeeper + Customer Support Specialist
description:
We're a growing flower business looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper who genuinely enjoys making numbers tie out to the penny. You'll own the daily financial pulse of the business — tracking every sale across Shopify, cash, and Zelle, reconciling team logs against actual payments, and catching discrepancies before they become problems.



This is not a passive data-entry role. We need someone who notices when something doesn't add up and digs until they find out why.



What You'll Do

Daily (the core of the job):

*Record all sales across Shopify, cash, and Zelle in QuickBooks

*Reconcile the team's daily sales logs against actual payments received

*Track inventory movement (incoming, sold, remaining, wastage)

*Flag discrepancies, missing items, or anything that looks off

*Submit a daily report summarizing sales, cash position, and any variances



Weekly:

*Maintain Excel reports for sales, inventory, and cash trends

*Prepare a weekly summary report for the owner

Reconcile bank activity and payment processor payouts



As needed:

*Respond to customer messages when the team is tied up

*Support the owner with light admin tasks tied to financial operations



What We're Looking For

Required:

*Real QuickBooks experience (you can explain the difference between a sales receipt and an invoice without thinking)

*Strong Excel skills — pivot tables, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and you build formulas, not just formatted tables

*Multi-channel sales reconciliation experience (ideally Shopify + cash + a digital payment app like Zelle, PayPal, GCash, etc.)

*Honest, calm, and methodical — you document your work and aren't defensive when asked to explain it

*Clear English communication, written and spoken

*Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the daily report



Bonus points for:

*Retail or perishable inventory experience

*Bookkeeping for a US-based small business

*Experience reconciling Shopify payouts (you know payout timing and fee handling)



What This Job Is Not

*It's not a place to learn QuickBooks from scratch — we need someone who already works in it daily.

*It's not a 9-to-5 with someone watching over you. You'll work independently, which means missed reports are immediately visible.

*It's not a stepping stone — we want someone who'll grow with us for at least 18–24 months. Bonuses and pay increases are tied to performance and tenure.



How to Apply

Send the following to 

1. A 1–2 minute voice recording answering this question: "Walk me through how you would handle this situation — at the end of the day, the team's sales log shows $1,847 in cash sales, but the cash drawer only has $1,790. What do you do?"

2. A sample of your bookkeeping or Excel work — a sanitized reconciliation, sales report, or inventory tracker you've actually built. Screenshots or files are fine. Templates downloaded from the internet don't count.

3. A short note with:

*Your years of QuickBooks experience

*Your current timezone and weekly hours of availability

*One sentence on why this role fits you right now



Applications missing any of these three items will not be reviewed. We're serious about detail — the application itself is the first test.

title: Client Success Manager – $2,000 p/m + Uncapped Commission
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:

mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

title: Amazon FBA Operations Manager – (High-Volume OA/Wholesale Support)
description:
I am an active Amazon seller currently moving between 800–1,200 units per month through Online Arbitrage and Wholesale. As the business scales, the logistics, sourcing coordination, and "profit leaks" are becoming too much to handle alone.



I am looking for a Right-Hand Operations Manager who actually understands the FBA ecosystem. I don't need a data entry clerk; I need someone who can look at my spreadsheets, identify where I'm losing money (tax, shipping, prep fees), and help me optimize the entire supply chain.



Your Role:



Cost Optimization: Identifying "Profit Leaks" in the sourcing process and finding ways to recover margin.



Sourcing Research: Finding high-volume, high-margin leads that fit our current model.



Growth Support: Assisting with high-level outreach to distributors and brands.



Skill Requirements

Amazon Expert: Must be proficient in Seller Central and FBA workflows.



Spreadsheet Ninja: Advanced Google Sheets/Excel skills for tracking unit costs and margins especially with SALES TAX states



Problem Solver: You must be able to explain one way you’ve saved a previous Amazon client money on their operations.



English Fluency: Professional written communication for US-based vendor outreach.



Tools: Experience with SellerAMP, Keepa, or Helium10 is a plus.

title: Marketing Designer
description:

We are looking for a **Marketing Designer** who can create high-quality visual assets that support marketing campaigns, brand initiatives, social media, advertising, and e-commerce growth. The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with an understanding of marketing, branding, and conversion-focused creative.



## Key Responsibilities



* Design creative assets for digital marketing campaigns, social media, paid advertising,
 marketing, websites, and e-commerce.

* Create static graphics, promotional materials, banners, landing page visuals, presentations, and other marketing collateral.

* Develop creative concepts based on campaign goals, target audiences, and brand guidelines.

* Collaborate with marketing, creative, and content teams to translate ideas into compelling visual content.

* Adapt designs into multiple formats and sizes for different platforms and campaigns.

* Maintain brand consistency across all marketing materials.

* Support product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and special marketing initiatives.

* Organize and maintain design files, templates, and creative assets.

* Stay updated on current design, social media, advertising, and e-commerce creative trends.



## Requirements
