title: Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller
description:
Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time 

Experience Required: 1–2 Years



Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as Prop Stream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins



Ready to Make Your Calls Count?



Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

Application – Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

title: Fractional Marketing Director
description:
# Fractional Marketing Director / Growth Marketing Lead for Growing Home-Service Company



NOTE: Candidates must have proven experience independently managing a company’s marketing strategy and execution, preferably within the home services industry.



## About the Role



Cultivate House Detailing is looking for an experienced, highly accountable **Fractional Marketing Director / Growth Marketing Lead** to take ownership of our lead-generation strategy.



We are a growing home-service company based in Colorado Springs, Colorado. Our services include window cleaning, gutter cleaning, pressure washing, holiday lighting, permanent lighting, screen repair, and other exterior home services.



Our primary marketing challenge is simple:



**We need to consistently generate more qualified leads at a profitable cost.**



We are not looking for someone who only posts on social media, runs a few ads, or gives us a list of recommendations. We need someone who can look at the entire marketing system, identify the biggest opportunities, create a focused plan, and ensure that the work gets completed.



This may begin as a fractional position. We care more about measurable results, ownership, and communication than a specific number of hours worked.



## Your Mission



Build and manage a predictable marketing system that produces qualified leads for Cultivate throughout the year.



You will be responsible for answering questions such as:



* Where should our next marketing dollar go?

* Which services, offers, and geographic areas should we prioritize?

* Why are campaigns succeeding or failing?

* What should we test next?

* Where are leads falling out of the funnel?

* How do we reduce our dependence on any single lead source?

* How do we prepare marketing campaigns ahead of our seasonal demand?



## What You Will Own



### Marketing Strategy



* Develop and maintain Cultivate’s overall marketing plan.

* Create quarterly, monthly, and weekly marketing priorities.

* Build campaigns around our seasonal service calendar.

* Identify the highest-impact opportunities for generating leads.

* Recommend appropriate budgets based on expected returns.

* Help develop stronger offers, hooks, promotions, and positioning.

* Turn leadership’s ideas into organized campaigns with deadlines and ownership.



### Paid Advertising



* Manage or oversee Google Ads and Meta advertising.

* Review campaign structure, keywords, targeting, creative, landing pages, and conversion tracking.

* Monitor cost per lead, cost per booked job, lead quality, and return on advertising spend.

* Create a structured testing process for ads, offers, audiences, and landing pages.

* Scale successful campaigns without allowing performance to deteriorate.

* Quickly identify and correct campaigns that are wasting money.



### Local Search and SEO



* Improve our visibility in Colorado Springs, Monument, Black Forest, Woodland Park, and surrounding service areas.

* Develop a practical local SEO plan.

* Improve service pages and location pages.

* Help manage our Google Business Profile strategy.

* Identify content opportunities that can generate qualified local traffic.

* Coordinate review-generation and reputation-marketing efforts.



### Website and Conversion Optimization



* Review the customer journey from the first click through booking.

* Improve landing pages, quote forms, calls to action, and conversion rates.

* Help launch and market our instant window-cleaning quote system.

* Work with our team or outside developers to implement website improvements.

* Make decisions using customer behavior and conversion data rather than personal preference.



###
, SMS, and Database Marketing



* Build campaigns that generate additional revenue from our existing customer and lead database.

* Create seasonal reactivation, cross-sell, upsell, referral, and follow-up campaigns.

* Improve lead nurturing for customers who request an estimate but do not immediately book.

* Develop campaigns that introduce existing customers to additional services.

* Coordinate messaging through Housecall Pro, OpenPhone, or other systems as appropriate.



### Content and Creative Direction



* Develop a practical content plan tied to lead generation and brand awareness.

* Create clear briefs for advertisements, videos,
s, landing pages, and social content.

* Help us find better advertising hooks and angles.

* Review creative work and provide specific, useful feedback.

* Personally write or edit important marketing copy when necessary.

* Coordinate freelancers, designers, editors, or other specialists when appropriate.



### Tracking and Reporting



* Make sure marketing attribution and conversion tracking are accurate.



* Develop a simple weekly marketing scorecard.



* Track metrics such as:



  * Leads by source

  * Qualified leads

  * Cost per lead

  * Cost per booked job

  * Booking rate

  * Revenue by lead source

  * Return on advertising spend

  * Website conversion rate

  * Speed to lead

  * Customer acquisition cost



* Send a concise weekly report explaining:



  * What happened

  * Why it happened

  * What was completed

  * What is being tested

  * What needs leadership’s attention

  * What will happen next



We do not want reports that only show traffic, impressions, followers, or activity. Reporting must connect marketing work to leads, booked jobs, and revenue.



## Strategy and Execution



This is not a purely advisory role.



You should be able to operate at three levels:



1. **Strategy:** Determine what Cultivate should do and why.

2. **Management:** Organize projects, assign work, and ensure deadlines are met.

3. **Execution:** Personally complete important work when hiring another specialist would be unnecessary or inefficient.



You do not need to be the world’s best specialist in every channel. You must, however, understand each major channel well enough to make good decisions, evaluate performance, and manage specialists effectively.



## What Success Looks Like



### During Your First 30 Days



* Learn our services, customer base, service area, seasonality, brand, and current sales process.

* Audit our current advertising, website, SEO, tracking, content, CRM, and follow-up systems.

* Identify immediate waste, broken tracking, and missed opportunities.

* Establish a simple marketing scorecard.

* Present a prioritized 90-day marketing plan.

* Begin implementing the highest-impact improvements.



### Within 60 to 90 Days



* Establish dependable campaign planning and reporting.

* Improve our ability to identify which channels produce booked work.

* Launch structured tests across our highest-priority channels.

* Improve lead follow-up and database reactivation.

* Build an organized campaign calendar for our major services.

* Demonstrate measurable progress in lead volume, lead quality, booking rate, or customer acquisition cost.



### Long-Term



* Build a diversified and predictable lead-generation system.

* Help Cultivate plan marketing proactively rather than reactively.

* Reduce wasted spending.

* Increase qualified leads and booked revenue.

* Create repeatable systems that can support the company as it grows.



## Required Experience



We are looking for someone who has:



* At least 4 years of meaningful digital marketing experience.

* Experience owning marketing outcomes, not merely completing assigned tasks.

* Strong working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads.

* Experience with local SEO and Google Business Profiles.

* Experience improving landing pages and conversion rates.

* Experience with
 and SMS marketing.

* Strong copywriting and offer-development skills.

* Experience reading marketing data and explaining it clearly.

* Experience managing multiple campaigns and deadlines.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong judgment, initiative, organization, and attention to detail.

* A history of working independently without needing constant instruction.



Experience marketing a home-service company, local service business, franchise, or appointment-based company is strongly preferred.



## Helpful Experience



These are not all required, but they would be valuable:



* Housecall Pro or another home-service CRM

* Google Analytics 4

* Google Tag Manager

* Looker Studio

* Call tracking

* WordPress

*
 and Instagram content

* YouTube or short-form video

* Direct mail or neighborhood marketing

* Referral programs

* Reputation management

* Seasonal campaign planning

* Managing designers, video editors, copywriters, or advertising specialists

* Using AI tools to improve speed without sacrificing quality



## Who Will Succeed in This Role



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Think like a business owner rather than a task-based freelancer.

* Ask good questions before spending money.

* Focus on revenue and qualified leads rather than vanity metrics.

* Are comfortable making recommendations and respectfully challenging weak ideas.

* Can create structure in an environment where many opportunities compete for attention.

* Communicate problems early rather than hiding them.

* Can explain complex marketing decisions in plain English.

* Know how to prioritize rather than attempting ten initiatives at once.

* Are equally comfortable analyzing numbers and developing creative ideas.

* Take responsibility for outcomes while being honest about what marketing can and cannot control.



## Who Should Not Apply



This role is probably not a fit if you:



* Only specialize in social media posting.

* Require detailed instructions for every task.

* Primarily measure success through followers, impressions, or engagement.

* Create strategies but depend on others to organize and implement everything.

* Cannot show examples of campaigns connected to leads, sales, or revenue.

* Take on more clients than you can properly support.

* Frequently miss deadlines or disappear when a project becomes difficult.

* Use generic AI-generated marketing plans without understanding the business.



## Schedule and Working Arrangement



This is a remote, flexible, results-based position.



We are open to a fractional arrangement, consulting relationship, or a larger ongoing role depending on the candidate’s experience and proposed approach.



You may generally organize your own working hours. However, you must be available for:



* A regular weekly marketing meeting.

* Occasional meetings during Colorado business hours.

* Timely communication when campaigns or tracking systems have problems.

* Reasonable collaboration with our Colorado-based leadership and operations team.



We are not requiring a full United States night shift.



## Compensation



Compensation is negotiable based on:



* Experience

* Demonstrated results

* Proposed scope

* Weekly capacity

* Whether you will personally execute work or manage other specialists



Please include your desired monthly compensation or retainer in your application.



We are interested in building a long-term relationship with the right person. We are open to beginning with a defined paid trial or initial 90-day engagement before expanding the role.



## How to Apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter.



Begin your application with the words:



**“I have experience independently managing a company's marketing strategy”**



Then answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about a company where you were responsible for generating leads. What was the business, what did you personally own, and what results did you achieve?



2. Which marketing channels are you strongest in? Which channels would you prefer to oversee rather than execute personally?



3. Imagine you joined Cultivate and discovered that we were running Google Ads and Meta Ads, publishing social content, and working on SEO, but no one could reliably explain which activities were creating booked jobs. What would you do during your first 30 days?



4. Give an example of a marketing campaign that was underperforming. How did you diagnose the problem, and what did you change?



5. What metrics would you include in a weekly marketing scorecard for a local home-service company?



6. How many clients or employers are you currently supporting?



7. How much capacity would you realistically have for Cultivate?



8. What monthly compensation or retainer are you requesting?



9. Please provide links, screenshots, case studies, reports, landing pages, advertisements, or other examples that demonstrate your work. You may remove confidential information.



10. Record a short video, no longer than five minutes, introducing yourself and explaining the first three things you would want to learn about our business.



## About Cultivate House Detailing



Cultivate House Detailing is a growing home-service company serving Colorado Springs and surrounding communities.



Our services include:



* Residential window cleaning

* Gutter cleaning

* Pressure washing and soft washing

* Screen repair and rebuilding

* Holiday light installation

* Permanent lighting

* Solar-panel pigeon protection

* Other exterior home-detailing services



Our company values are:



* Empathy

* Humility

* Community

* Growth



We care about excellent customer service, strong communication, employee development, and building a company that serves both our customers and our community well.



We are looking for someone who wants to help build a marketing department, not simply complete a temporary list of tasks.

These are not all required, but they would be valuable:



* Housecall Pro or another home-service CRM

* Google Analytics 4

* Google Tag Manager

* Looker Studio

* Call tracking

* WordPress

*
 and Instagram content

* YouTube or short-form video

* Direct mail or neighborhood marketing

* Referral programs

* Reputation management

* Seasonal campaign planning

* Managing designers, video editors, copywriters, or advertising specialists

* Using AI tools to improve speed without sacrificing quality



## Who Will Succeed in This Role



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Think like a business owner rather than a task-based freelancer.

* Ask good questions before spending money.

* Focus on revenue and qualified leads rather than vanity metrics.

* Are comfortable making recommendations and respectfully challenging weak ideas.

* Can create structure in an environment where many opportunities compete for attention.

* Communicate problems early rather than hiding them.

* Can explain complex marketing decisions in plain English.

* Know how to prioritize rather than attempting ten initiatives at once.

* Are equally comfortable analyzing numbers and developing creative ideas.

* Take responsibility for outcomes while being honest about what marketing can and cannot control.

* Want to become deeply familiar with a company rather than simply completing isolated marketing projects.



## Who Should Not Apply



This role is probably not a fit if you:



* Only specialize in social media posting.

* Require detailed instructions for every task.

* Primarily measure success through followers, impressions, or engagement.

* Create strategies but depend on others to organize and implement everything.

* Cannot show examples of campaigns connected to leads, sales, or revenue.

* Have other commitments that prevent you from consistently owning your responsibilities.

* Frequently miss deadlines or disappear when a project becomes difficult.

* Use generic AI-generated marketing plans without understanding the business.



## Schedule and Working Arrangement



This is a remote, ongoing position.



You will have flexibility in how you organize much of your working day, but this role requires consistent availability, communication, and collaboration with our team.



You must be available for:



* A regular weekly marketing meeting.

* Regular collaboration with leadership and other team members.

* Occasional meetings during Colorado business hours.

* Timely communication when campaigns, leads, websites, or tracking systems have problems.

* Reasonable overlap with our Colorado-based leadership and operations team.



For candidates working internationally, we do not require a complete United States night-shift schedule, but sufficient overlap with Colorado business hours will be necessary for effective collaboration.



## Compensation



Compensation is negotiable based on:



* Experience

* Demonstrated results

* Scope of capabilities

* Level of strategic ownership

* Ability to personally execute work versus managing other specialists



Please include your desired monthly compensation in your application.



We are interested in building a long-term relationship with the right person and may begin with a defined paid trial or introductory period before transitioning fully into the role.



## How to Apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter.



Begin your application with the words:



**“I have experience independently managing a company's marketing strategy”**



Then answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about a company where you were responsible for generating leads. What was the business, what did you personally own, and what results did you achieve?



2. Which marketing channels are you strongest in? Which channels would you prefer to oversee rather than execute personally?



3. Imagine you joined Cultivate and discovered that we were running Google Ads and Meta Ads, publishing social content, and working on SEO, but no one could reliably explain which activities were creating booked jobs. What would you do during your first 30 days?



4. Give an example of a marketing campaign that was underperforming. How did you diagnose the problem, and what did you change?



5. What metrics would you include in a weekly marketing scorecard for a local home-service company?



6. What is your current employment situation, and do you have any ongoing commitments that would affect your availability for this role?



7. When would you be available to begin?



8. What monthly compensation are you requesting?



9. Please provide links, screenshots, case studies, reports, landing pages, advertisements, or other examples that demonstrate your work. You may remove confidential information.



10. Record a short video, no longer than five minutes, introducing yourself and explaining the first three things you would want to learn about our business.



## About Cultivate House Detailing



Cultivate House Detailing is a growing home-service company serving Colorado Springs and surrounding communities.



Our services include:



* Residential window cleaning

* Gutter cleaning

* Pressure washing and soft washing

* Screen repair and rebuilding

* Holiday light installation

* Permanent lighting

* Solar-panel pigeon protection

* Other exterior home-detailing services



Our company values are:



* Empathy

* Humility

* Community

* Growth



We care about excellent customer service, strong communication, employee development, and building a company that serves both our customers and our community well.



We are looking for someone who wants to help build and lead a marketing department as an important part of our company’s continued growth.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a creative and highly reliable short-form video editor to join our team long term and help us create engaging content for ZilliFi.



This is NOT a one-time freelance project. We’re looking for someone who wants consistent work, steady weekly projects, and the opportunity to become our go-to video editor as we continue growing.



You’ll be producing a minimum of 5 short-form videos per week, with scripts provided in advance so you can organize your workload and plan your week efficiently.



**EDITING STYLE WE’RE LOOKING FOR**



Reference video:


==



We’re looking for editing that includes:



* Fast-paced, high-retention storytelling

* Dynamic captions and typography

* Motion graphics and animations

* Frequent visual changes and pattern interrupts

* Relevant B-roll and visual storytelling

* Strong sound effects and sound design

* Zooms, transitions, and intentional movement

* Visual emphasis on important words, numbers, and statements

* Strong pacing designed to keep viewers watching



We want someone who understands how to turn a script into a polished, entertaining, high-retention video.



**WHY JOIN US?**



This is a long-term opportunity.



You’ll receive consistent weekly work and batches of scripts in advance so you know what you’re working on each week.



Our goal is to build a reliable workflow where you don’t have to constantly search for your next project. As our content grows, there will also be opportunities for increased video volume and additional responsibilities.



**WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU**



* Ability to complete at least 5 videos per week

* Reliable communication

* Consistent ability to meet deadlines

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to closely follow reference videos and creative direction

* Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

* Understanding of short-form retention and social media content

* Interest in working with us long term



**TRIAL VIDEO REQUIRED**



Before bringing an editor onto our team, we require a trial sample reel.



We’ll provide the script and reference video. The trial allows us to see how you interpret the ZilliFi brand and whether you can match the pacing, motion graphics, captions, sound design, and overall energy we’re looking for.



Please only apply if you are willing to complete the FREE trial reel as part of our hiring process.



**HOW TO APPLY**



IMPORTANT: Your application MUST start with the word:



**ZILLIFI**



If your application does not begin with ZILLIFI, we will assume you did not read the entire job description.



Then include:



1. 2–5 of your BEST short-form edits that most closely match our reference video.



2. Your rate per completed video based on consistent weekly work.



3. Your typical turnaround time.



4. Confirmation that you can consistently complete 5+ videos per week.



5. Confirmation that you’re willing to complete the FREE trial sample reel.



6. A short introduction about your editing experience and why you’d be a good fit for our team.



Please do NOT send a huge portfolio of unrelated videos. We want to see your strongest and most relevant short-form work.



We’re looking to hire as soon as possible, so applicants who are ready to start immediately will be prioritized.



If you’re a talented editor looking for consistent work, reliable income, and a company you can grow with long term, we’d love to hear from you.



**Start your application with "ZILLIFI" and send us your best work.**

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
About us

True AV is a live event production company based just outside Salt Lake City. We do sound, lighting, and video for corporate events, conferences, galas, and high-end weddings — usually the ones with a live band on stage. Our founder spent 10 years touring as a production manager and has mixed thousands of bands, so we handle live music better than almost anyone in our market.



We are small on purpose and growing fast. Our name means something: we tell clients the truth about what things cost and what they're getting. We expect the same honesty internally.

Right now the owner is doing too much of the back office himself. That's the job we're hiring for.



What you'll actually do

This is not a "post to Instagram and check
" role. You will be the operational spine of the company. 

Day to day:



Scheduling & crew coordination

Maintain the master event calendar so nothing ever double-books

Reach out to our subcontractor crew (audio techs, lighting techs, camera ops) to staff each event, confirm call times, and chase down anyone who hasn't confirmed

Keep the crew database current — availability, rates, certifications, contact info

Send call sheets and reminders before every event



Vendor management

Coordinate with venues, rental houses, staging companies, and other AV vendors

Track gear rental orders, delivery windows, and returns

Follow up relentlessly. Nothing sits unanswered.



Quotes & proposals

Draft itemized quotes and proposals from the owner's notes or a short voice memo

Keep our pricing sheets and proposal templates accurate and up to date

Follow up on outstanding quotes on a schedule (this is where most of our lost revenue hides)



Government & institutional bids

Research open RFPs and bid opportunities on government, university, and municipal procurement portals

Read the requirements, flag the ones worth pursuing, and assemble the submission packet

Track deadlines, registrations, and required documentation so we never miss a filing window



Bookkeeping & bill pay

Categorize transactions and keep the books clean and current (QuickBooks Online)

Pay vendor bills on schedule; send client invoices and chase receivables

Reconcile accounts monthly and flag anything that looks off

Track event profitability so we know which jobs actually made money



Insurance & compliance

Request and send certificates of insurance (COIs) to venues and clients, often on short notice

Keep policies, W-9s, and subcontractor paperwork organized and current

Communicate with our insurance broker on renewals and claims



Social media management

Manage Instagram,
, and LinkedIn: schedule posts, write captions, respond to comments and DMs

Build content from the photos and video we capture at events (basic editing in Canva or CapCut)

Keep a consistent posting rhythm so we look as active as we actually are

Who this is for



You'll do well here if:

You have 3+ years supporting a US-based small business owner as an EA or operations VA

You have real bookkeeping experience, not just data entry. QuickBooks Online proficiency is required.

You are comfortable writing quotes, proposals, and professional
s in flawless English

You genuinely enjoy research, digging through a procurement portal to find the one bid worth chasing sounds interesting to you, not tedious

You are the kind of person who notices a conflict on the calendar before anyone else does

You follow up without being asked. Twice. Three times if needed.

You can hold a lot of moving pieces at once without dropping any of them



Nice to have (not required):

Experience in events, AV, production, construction, or another scheduling-heavy service business

Experience with government contracting or RFP responses

Design skills in Canva



Tools we use or will use: Google Workspace, QuickBooks Online, Canva, and a project management tool (Asana or ClickUp). If you don't know one of these but learn software quickly, say so.



What we offer

Full-time, long-term, stable work with a growing company

Direct access to the owner, no layers of management

Real ownership over your areas. Once you've earned trust, you run them.

Room to grow into an Operations Manager role as we scale

title: Expert Real Estate ISA & Lead Conversion Specialist | U.S. Real Estate Team
description:
READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are looking for a HIGH-PERFORMING, EXPERIENCED REAL ESTATE ISA / COLD CALLER to join a busy U.S.-based real estate team. This is NOT an administrative VA position and is NOT for someone learning how to cold call. You must already know how to prospect, WHERE to find quality real estate leads, how to research prospects, how to use real estate systems, and how to convert conversations into opportunities.



Our immediate priority is an aggressive 14-day prospecting campaign for a $1.49M luxury waterfront land listing in Sarasota, Florida. You will be expected to actively identify and prospect potential buyers, Realtors with qualified buyers, investors, builders, developers, neighboring property owners, past leads, and other targeted prospects.



We are NOT providing you with every lead and simply asking you to dial. We want someone experienced enough to help FIND and BUILD targeted prospecting lists and then work those lists aggressively.



If you perform, this can become a LONG-TERM position with our real estate team handling buyer leads, seller leads, database follow-up, prospecting, appointment setting, and lead conversion.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Make 100–150+ outbound calls per day during dedicated prospecting campaigns.

Know where and how to find real estate leads instead of waiting for leads to be handed to you.

Research and build targeted prospecting lists.

Cold call Realtors, buyers, sellers, investors, builders, developers, property owners, and other targeted prospects.

Research agents who have previously represented buyers or sellers of comparable properties.

Work with MLS-generated prospecting information and understand how MLS data can be used to identify opportunities.

Use Realtor and real-estate-related websites, databases, public information, CRM data, and approved prospecting resources to locate potential leads.

Follow up by phone, text, and
 using approved systems and processes.

Qualify motivation, timeline, financing, property needs, and readiness.

Handle objections confidently without sounding scripted or robotic.

Turn conversations into qualified appointments, showings, and opportunities.

Follow up consistently until we receive a clear outcome.

Maintain accurate notes and follow-up dates in our CRM/tracking system.

Immediately escalate HOT prospects to the Team Principal.

Provide daily reporting of calls, conversations, leads, appointments, follow-ups, and results.

YOU MUST HAVE

Proven U.S. REAL ESTATE ISA / cold-calling experience.

Experience working with MLS information and Realtor-related tools/platforms.

Strong understanding of how U.S. Realtors prospect for buyers and sellers.

Proven ability to research and source your own targeted leads.

Experience using real estate CRMs, dialers, lead databases, property research tools, and prospecting systems.

YOUR OWN reliable professional phone/dialing system capable of calling U.S. numbers.

Your own reliable computer, professional headset, high-speed internet, and quiet workspace.

Excellent spoken English with clear, professional communication.

Strong phone presence, confidence, energy, and sales ability.

Demonstrated objection-handling and appointment-setting ability.

Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Strong organization and follow-through.

Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

A competitive, results-driven mentality.

DO NOT APPLY IF:

You have never professionally cold-called U.S. real estate prospects.

You are primarily an administrative VA who occasionally makes calls.

You expect us to provide every phone number and lead for you.

You do not know how to research and build a targeted real estate prospecting list.

You have no familiarity with MLS data or U.S. Realtor tools.

You do not have your own reliable U.S. calling/dialing system.

You are uncomfortable making 100+ outbound calls per day.

You give up after one or two attempts to reach a prospect.

You are afraid of rejection or uncomfortable asking directly for an appointment.

You need a script for every possible situation and cannot think on your feet.

You frequently miss shifts, interviews, meetings, or deadlines.

You cannot work consistently during U.S. Eastern Time.

You are looking for an easy position with minimal performance expectations.



We are looking for a PRODUCER and PROSPECTOR — not simply someone to make calls.



PERFORMANCE MATTERS



You will be measured on prospects identified, actual conversations, qualified leads, appointments, follow-up execution, and opportunities generated — not simply hours worked.



We want someone who can be given a property, market, lead type, or objective and confidently determine:



WHO should we prospect? WHERE do we find them? HOW do we reach them? HOW do we convert them?



For the right person, we are interested in building a long-term relationship and rewarding strong performance.



TO APPLY — FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS EXACTLY



Start your application with:



“I AM YOUR ISA.”



Then provide:



How many years of U.S. real estate ISA/cold-calling experience you have.

Your typical number of outbound calls and live conversations during an 8-hour shift.

Your average appointments set per week in your most recent real estate ISA position.

The MLS systems, Realtor tools, CRMs, dialers, lead databases, and prospecting platforms you have personally used.

Explain where YOU would find buyer prospects for a $1.49M Sarasota waterfront land listing if hired tomorrow.

Tell us what phone/dialing system you currently own/use to make U.S. outbound calls.

Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time.

Your requested hourly rate.

Provide a 60–90 second voice or video recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are a top-performing ISA.

Give one example of a difficult real estate objection you successfully overcame.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We are interviewing and hiring IMMEDIATELY. If you are an experienced real estate prospector who knows how to find the lead, make the call, handle the objection, follow up, and create the opportunity, we want to hear from you.

We're a US-based performance marketing agency running paid Meta ad campaigns for med spas and aesthetics clinics (CO2 laser resurfacing, injectables, body contouring, skin treatments, etc.). We need a video editor who has actually worked on ads in this space — not a general editor who needs hand-holding on what a med spa ad should look or feel like.



This is not a "give me the footage and I'll tell you what to cut" role. You need to be able to look at a folder of raw B-roll (or no B-roll at all) and know how to turn it into a scroll-stopping 15–30 second ad, because you've seen what works in this category before.



What You'll Be Doing



Editing 15–30 second vertical video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) for med spa and aesthetics clients

Working from client-provided B-roll in shared Google Drive folders — organizing, selecting, and cutting usable clips into a finished ad

When there's no usable B-roll: sourcing licensed stock footage of relevant treatments (CO2 laser, skin resurfacing, facials, body contouring, etc.) to build a video from scratch

Adding captions, trending/on-brand music, pacing edits, hooks, and text overlays appropriate for direct-response Meta ads (not brand/cinematic edits — these need to convert)

Building static before/after image ads when a client's assets call for a static creative instead of video

Researching the
 Ads Library for competitor and inspiration ads in the med spa / aesthetics / CO2 laser space before starting a new edit, and using that research to inform hooks, pacing, and style

Producing multiple style variations (e.g., UGC-style vs. clinical/premium vs. fast-cut trend style) depending on the client and offer

Delivering finished files in the correct spec/aspect ratio for Meta placements, on a fast turnaround



Who This Is For



You have direct experience editing ads for med spas, aesthetics clinics, dermatology, injectables, or similar high-ticket local service/beauty brands — not just general social content

You know how to use the
 Ads Library to scout competitor and inspiration ads without being told to

You have access to (or know where to source) stock/licensed footage of laser and aesthetic treatments

You can look at a raw folder of clips and figure out the story/hook/structure yourself — you do not need a shot list or a script handed to you

You're comfortable making creative calls independently and only flagging genuine blockers (like missing an asset entirely) — not asking "what do you want on the video?"

You understand direct-response video editing (hook in the first 2–3 seconds, captions, pattern interrupts, pacing for retention) as distinct from general video editing

Strong English communication for async Slack/Drive-based workflows



Nice to Have



Experience with GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, or working directly inside an agency environment

A portfolio that includes actual med spa/aesthetics ad examples (not just general reels/edits)



How to Apply



Please include:



A portfolio or reel with specific examples of med spa, aesthetics, or medical/beauty ad edits (not general content)

One example of a before/after static ad you've built, if you have one

A short note on your process: how you'd approach a folder of raw B-roll with no brief, from research to finished ad

title: Google Ads Search Specialist – $250–$300 Per Account + Separate Setup Fee
description:
## Position Overview



We are a U.S.-based marketing company seeking an experienced Google Ads specialist to build and manage Search campaigns for local service businesses.



This is a completely white-label subcontractor position. You will work behind the scenes as part of our internal team. You will communicate with our company and will not communicate directly with our clients.



We are starting with one Google Ads account. Additional accounts may be assigned if the relationship is successful.



## Compensation



This position is paid per active Google Ads account managed. It is not an hourly position or a general monthly salary covering unlimited work.



* Ongoing management: $250–$300 USD per month, per active account

* Expected ongoing workload: approximately three to five hours per week for the initial account

* Initial campaign research, setup, tracking, testing and launch are paid separately as a one-time fixed-price project

* Additional accounts are compensated separately

* Work outside the normal management scope requires prior approval



Please include your requested monthly management fee within the listed range and your separate one-time campaign setup fee in your application.



## Initial Campaign Responsibilities



* Research the local market and competitors

* Complete keyword research

* Build the Google Search campaign

* Organize campaigns and ad groups properly

* Write conversion-focused ads

* Configure geographic targeting

* Create an initial negative-keyword list

* Set up call and form conversion tracking

* Verify that conversions are recording correctly

* Review the landing page and recommend improvements

* Launch the campaign after internal approval

* Complete post-launch quality assurance



## Ongoing Account Management



* Review search terms and add negative keywords

* Monitor geographic traffic and exclude irrelevant locations

* Review bids, budgets, keywords and match types

* Test and improve ads and assets

* Monitor call and form conversions

* Identify tracking or campaign problems

* Work to improve cost per qualified lead

* Maintain a record of important campaign changes

* Provide a short weekly internal update

* Prepare a simple monthly performance summary



## Required Experience



You must have direct experience managing Google Search campaigns for U.S. local-service businesses.



Relevant industries include:



* Contractors

* Home-service companies

* Environmental services

* Testing and inspection companies

* Restoration companies

* Other appointment- or estimate-based service businesses



You must be comfortable working with:



* Google Ads

* Google Tag Manager

* Google Analytics 4

* Call and form conversion tracking

* Keyword match types

* Negative-keyword management

* Search-term analysis

* Location targeting

* Lead-quality optimization

* Google Ads policy and account issues



Experience generating qualified leads for local service businesses is more important than e-commerce experience.



Strong spoken and written English is required. You must be able to understand instructions, participate in video calls, explain campaign decisions and communicate effectively with our internal team.



## White-Label Requirements



You must agree to the following:



* No direct communication with our clients

* No disclosure of your involvement

* No personal, freelance or agency branding in campaigns, reports or shared files

* No contacting or soliciting our clients

* No use of client work in your portfolio without written permission

* All reports and updates are delivered internally to our company

* Major campaign, strategy and budget changes require our approval

* All client and campaign information must remain confidential

* All account access must be returned or removed when the engagement ends



## Required Loom Video



A three-to-five-minute Loom video is required with your application.



Applications without a working Loom video link will not be considered.



In your Loom video:



1. Briefly introduce yourself and explain your Google Ads experience.



2. Show a Google Ads campaign that you personally managed. You may hide or blur the client’s name, account number and other sensitive information.



3. Explain the campaign and ad-group structure.



4. Show how conversions were tracked.



5. Explain how you reviewed search terms and added negative keywords.



6. Describe one specific optimization decision you made and why you made it.



7. Explain the results you personally helped produce.



The purpose of the Loom video is to confirm your communication skills, technical understanding and direct involvement in managing Google Ads campaigns.



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the words:



**LOCAL SEARCH**



Applications that do not begin with those words will not be considered.



Then provide the following:



1. Your required three-to-five-minute Loom video link.



2. A description of two U.S. local-service Google Ads accounts you personally managed. Include the industries, approximate monthly ad spend, leads generated and average cost per lead.



3. An explanation of how you track phone calls and website form submissions accurately.



4. The first three things you would investigate if a campaign generated clicks but no qualified leads.



5. Your requested monthly management fee within the listed $250–$300 per-account range.



6. Your requested one-time fee to research, build, track, test and launch the initial campaign.



7. Confirmation that you are comfortable working completely white-label with no direct client communication.



Generic applications, copied proposals and applications without relevant local-service Google Ads experience will not be considered.



## Selection Process



Qualified applicants will be invited to a video interview.



The finalist will complete a small paid campaign-planning test before being given access to the account. This is not an unpaid trial.



## Employment Details



* Part-time freelance contractor

* Paid per active Google Ads account managed

* Approximately three to five hours per week for the initial account

* Flexible working hours

* Long-term opportunity

* Potential for additional accounts based on performance

title: Beverage Operations & Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
About Bear Maple Farms:

Bear Maple Farms is a U.S. beverage company making clean, functional sodas. We currently have four SKUs distributed through natural and specialty retailers, Amazon and distributors across the United States. We're a small, entrepreneurial company building simple, reliable systems that allow the business to operate efficiently with a lean team. This role will take ownership of our beverage operations and supply chain and work directly with our CEO and external manufacturing, ingredient, logistics and distribution partners.



Time & Compensation:

$800 USD/month. Approximately 6–12 hours per week on average, with workload varying based on production schedules. This is an ongoing part-time role. We care about ownership, reliability and results rather than hours worked.



Key Responsibilities:

The Beverage Operations & Supply Chain Coordinator owns Bear Maple's beverage operations and supply chain end-to-end. We have four SKUs, a few production runs per year, and a small network of manufacturing, ingredient, warehouse and distribution partners. Your job is to keep product in stock, production running smoothly, and inventory healthy without requiring day-to-day founder involvement.



Production & Supply Chain:

-Own production runs from planning through finished goods, managing co-packer relationships and maintaining readiness with primary and backup manufacturing partners.

-Manage purchasing and availability of ingredients, cans, packaging and other production inputs.

-Coordinate beverage-production requirements including can printing, quality control, processing/pasteurization, filtration, shelf life, labeling and certifications.

-Coordinate freight and movement of materials and finished goods between suppliers, co-packers, warehouses, distributors and Amazon.

-Coordinate with our beverage formulator to ensure formulas, specifications, QC requirements and production documentation are complete and delivered to the co-packer.

-Own operational execution of new SKUs through commercial production, coordinating formulation, samples, approvals, packaging/artwork, documentation and manufacturing timelines.



Inventory:

-Maintain accurate inventory visibility and forecasts across all locations.

-Maintain the production calendar and proactively initiate production based on inventory forecasts and lead times.

-Anticipate production and replenishment needs before stockouts occur.

-Monitor aging inventory and proactively manage excess or short-dated product.

-Coordinate replenishment to distributors, warehouses and Amazon.



Ownership & Reporting:

-Serve as the primary operational point of contact for supply chain partners and drive issues through resolution.

-Maintain simple inventory, production and shipment reporting, SOPs and key operational information.

-Provide a concise weekly update covering inventory health, production, shipments, risks and decisions needed.



Experience:

-Hands-on operations or supply chain experience, including direct experience with shelf-stable canned beverages and beverage co-packers/contract manufacturers.

-Experience managing beverage production runs, purchasing, inventory planning, freight and warehousing.

-Working knowledge of beverage packaging, including can sourcing/printing, quality control, processing, shelf life and labeling requirements.

-Experience working with distributors and Amazon FBA is a plus.



Ideal Candidate:

You have actually done this before. You understand how a shelf-stable canned beverage gets from ingredients and empty cans through a co-packer and into warehouses and distributors, and you know what can go wrong along the way. You think ahead, prevent problems, follow through relentlessly, and create calm through preparation and organization. You solve routine issues independently and escalate complex issues early, with clear context and recommended next steps. You're comfortable owning the function and involving the CEO only when a decision or intervention is genuinely needed.

I’m looking for someone who is creative, experienced, proactive, and knows how to take ideas and turn them into content people actually want to watch, share, save, and respond to.



What You’ll Do

You’ll take my stories, ideas, photos, videos, coaching calls, podcasts, voice notes, properties, and other raw material and turn them into excellent reels and other social media content.



Sometimes I’ll give you the idea. Sometimes you’ll need to recognize the great content hiding inside something I’ve already created.



I don’t want to storyboard every reel or tell you exactly what to post.



I want you bringing ideas to me.



You should understand great hooks, storytelling, editing, pacing, retention, and what makes people stop scrolling.

Some of my best ideas haven’t been filmed.



You need hands-on experience using AI video tools such as HeyGen, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, or similar tools to turn creative concepts into polished, engaging content.



I don’t care which AI tools you prefer. I care about what you can create with them.



You should be able to take an idea and figure out how to make it happen without requiring actors, a videographer, or a traditional video shoot every time.



The finished product should look intentional, entertaining, and polished, not like generic AI content.



If you haven’t personally created high-quality AI video content yet, this isn’t the right position.



3. Turn Content Into Growth And Revenue

Great content isn’t enough. I want it to grow both businesses.



You should understand how to move people from:



Content ? Audience ? Leads ? Funnel ? Customers ? Revenue



That includes calls to action,
 marketing, landing pages, funnels, offers, bookings, sales, and understanding which content is actually producing business results.



You’ll also handle the implementation that supports the strategy, including social media posting,
 campaigns, website updates, and funnels.



Who I’m Looking For

I want someone who thinks, not someone who simply waits for instructions.



You should be creative, proactive, resourceful, commercially minded, and comfortable taking ownership.



If something isn’t working, I want you to notice.



If you see an opportunity, I want you to bring it to me.



If you have a great content idea, I want you to run with it.



To Apply

One example of a business or account you helped grow. Tell me what you did and the results you achieved.

I’m looking for someone who can help turn content into a meaningful growth engine for two businesses.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand focused on delivering high-quality products and an excellent customer experience. We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager who can turn data, customer insights, and strong execution into profitable growth.



About the Role

The Marketing Manager will own Starbond’s direct-to-consumer growth engine across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion optimization, and agency performance. This role requires a strong command of unit economics—including customer lifetime value (LTV), customer acquisition cost (CAC), CAC payback period, gross margin, and contribution margin—and the ability to convert these metrics into sound growth decisions.



You will directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google,
, and AEO while leading the internal Marketing team, setting clear performance standards, and giving the CEO timely visibility into results, risks, and recommended actions.



Key Responsibilities



DTC Growth and Customer Acquisition

Develop and lead the DTC acquisition strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify,
, SEO, social media, Amazon alignment, and other relevant channels.

Manage marketing for profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone—by incorporating product margin, contribution margin, retention, and customer quality into decisions.

Establish acceptable CAC thresholds by product, customer segment, campaign, and channel, and recommend when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue investment.

Align advertising, creative, landing pages, offers, product positioning, inventory availability, and operational readiness.



LTV, Retention, and Lifecycle Marketing

Maintain a clear and consistent LTV methodology using customer revenue, purchase frequency, retention, gross margin or contribution margin, and cohort data.

Analyze LTV and retention by acquisition source, product, cohort, and customer segment, and use the findings to improve channel and offer decisions.

Lead strategies that improve repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, average order value, cross-sell, replenishment, retention, and win-back performance.

Oversee
 and lifecycle marketing quality, segmentation, deliverability, revenue contribution, and customer communication accuracy.



Paid Advertising and Conversion

Oversee paid media strategy, budget pacing, campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, attribution, and landing-page performance.

Establish clear testing, scaling, optimization, and stop-loss rules, and require decisions to be supported by sufficient data and financial context.

Review performance at the channel, campaign, audience, creative, product, and cohort levels.

Partner with the Web Developer on Shopify priorities, site performance, conversion rate optimization, tracking, and quality assurance.



Agency and Vendor Management

Directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google,
, and AEO, including scopes of work, deliverables, timelines, communication standards, SLAs, KPIs, reporting, ownership, and escalation procedures.

Use agency scorecards and recurring performance reviews to track KPI attainment, SLA compliance, output quality, timeliness, efficiency, and business results.

Require root-cause analysis and time-bound corrective action plans for missed targets, SLA breaches, quality issues, reporting gaps, or inefficient spend.

Independently validate agency recommendations and recommend contract expansion, renegotiation, reduction, replacement, or termination when appropriate.

Ensure Starbond retains access to and ownership of advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Content, Creative, and Brand

Maintain an active content and creative pipeline supported by clear briefs, owners, deadlines, QA standards, and success metrics.

Ensure reliable content-production support is available when external resources are required.

Create a structured process for testing creative concepts, hooks, formats, messages, offers, and calls to action.

Protect product positioning and perceived value by avoiding excessive reliance on discounting and ensuring marketing claims are accurate and supportable.

Ensure approved assets are properly named, organized, and stored in company-owned systems.



Team Leadership, Process, and Reporting

Lead the internal Marketing team by setting clear responsibilities, deadlines, quality standards, KPIs, communication expectations, and individual performance targets.

Conduct regular coaching, one-on-ones, performance reviews, and accountability conversations; identify skill gaps and coordinate development or corrective action with HR.

Make timely recommendations regarding training, role clarity, workload changes, reassignment, or other performance actions when standards are not met.

Create and maintain marketing processes, approval flows, reporting definitions, campaign documentation, and quality-control systems.

Maintain a weekly marketing scorecard that distinguishes leading and lagging indicators and explains what changed, why it changed, and what action is required.

Proactively escalate material risks and present concise, financially grounded recommendations to the CEO.



What Success Looks Like



Marketing data, forecasts, campaign reports, creative briefs, and recommendations are accurate, validated, and financially grounded.

Campaigns, agency deliverables, reports, corrective actions, and launches are completed on time, with blockers escalated early.

CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, and cohort performance are consistently defined and used to guide decisions.

Marketing investment produces profitable customer growth, stronger retention, faster learning, higher-quality execution, and stronger brand protection.

The Marketing team and external agencies operate with clear ownership, measurable standards, and consistent accountability.



What We’re Looking For



Proven experience leading DTC or e-commerce marketing across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, and conversion optimization.

Strong working knowledge of CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, cohort analysis, and marketing attribution.

Experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads,
 marketing, SEO, AEO, Shopify, and agency partners.

Demonstrated ability to manage budgets and make channel decisions based on profitability and customer quality.

Experience leading and developing marketing team members, setting KPIs, and managing performance.

Strong analytical judgment with the ability to challenge assumptions, validate agency recommendations, and translate data into clear actions.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proactive and concise reporting style.

Highly organized, accountable, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-moving environment.



Tools and Platforms

Google Workspace, ClickUp, Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Amazon advertising and marketplace reports, Google Analytics, Looker Studio or Power BI, Klaviyo or a similar lifecycle platform, spreadsheets, and agency reporting systems.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter that addresses the following:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Share an example of how you used CAC, LTV, contribution margin, retention, or cohort data to make a marketing decision.

Describe your experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to KPIs and deadlines.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, and lifecycle marketing platforms you have used.



Applications that include specific examples and measurable outcomes will receive priority consideration.

title: Short Form Video Editor - TikTok Shop Ad
description:
Short Form Video Editor  - TikTok Shop



I am seeking a detail oriented, efficient short form video editor with experience editing Tiktok Shop videos, an eye for detail for recreating existing TikTok shop videos. The ideal candidate understands the importance of visual, verbal, and on screen text hooks, content that grabs attention and stops the scroll, keeping the viewer watching through quick cuts, zoom ins, and a strong call to action at the end of the video. 



In the beginning this will likely be roughly 10 hours a week but for the right candidate this could be a long term relationship, with the opportunity for many many more additional hours. (See below)



How it would work:



I will provide you with long 3-5 min unedited video clips, and voice over files. I will then send you links of an example TikTok posts that have proven to go viral or earn sales. Your job will to be to take the provided clips and audio to recreate the example video that was sent by link. So you must have an eye for detail, the videos should be as close to the original as possible. 



Once I can see that you have grasped the editing style that is effective, that is when hours can increase to however much you would like to work, essentially you would just taking videos you have edited that have been proven successful and rearranging the clips in a different order to repurpose old content that is very similar without it being an identical recreation. 



Here are several examples so you can see the Tiktok shop style of video similar to the ones I will be asking for you to recreate:



www.tiktok.com/@socially_ari/video/7671750981738138910

www.tiktok.com/@fadedzyx0/video/7672494156719115550

www.tiktok.com/@mcjerbear/video/7671133659210009869

https://www.tiktok.com/@kid.shops/video/7670970819480194334

www.tiktok.com/@ericsfindss/video/7657243157385547022

www.tiktok.com/@makegardenmagic/video/7671178506591653151

www.tiktok.com/@ajsdealshub/video/7669834266267651342



Editing Experience Required:



- You MUST have experience editing Tiktok shop style videos (if you only have experience with slow paced "get ready with me" UGC style influencer short form videos, or only long form videos you are not a good fit, please do not apply)

- Short-form vertical videos (7 seconds to 45 seconds) with tight cuts, speeding up audio, removing filler/dead air, extremely quick pacing that holds retention

- Photo overlays (for before & afters) and taking screenshots of videos to use the same reference photos as the video that is being created

- Captions/subtitles

- On screen text



You should have: 



1. Have a reel/portfolio of short form edits specifically of Tiktok shop style edits that you can provide direct links to.

2. Have and understanding for super quick pacing and retention (you know how to stop the scroll) 

3. Can match an existing video rather than trying to create your own (I'll give you examples to recreate) including screenshotting and using photo overlays that are in the existing video.

4. Are reliable with starting on time, can communicate proactively about timelines..

5. You feel comfortable asking for something when is not there (for example if the inspiration video has a a section where I have not provided you matching video or audio was not created, I want to be informed)



Tools



- Confident in Capcut or any other video editor (vertical landscape edits for TikTok)

- Comfortable receiving large raw files via DropBox or Google Drive



Requirements

1. Editing computer that can handle 1080p/4K footage

2. Reliable internet with solid upload speed (you'll need to be able to move large files)

3. About 10 hrs/week availability, ongoing, with the ability for that to drastically increase

4. Can deliver items in 72 hours or less (ideally 24hrs or less) around revisions quickly and take feedback well

5. Must be and EXTREMELY fast editor with the ability to edit 2-4 videos in one hour



How to apply (read carefully)



A direct link to the best examples of your previous Tiktok shop style edits (required), please do not provide links to websites, portfolio landing pages, or portfolio folders where I will need to sift through several edits that are not good examples of what I am looking for. I have provided many example links for you to understand what I am looking for, if you do not have experience with Tiktok Shop style edits unfortunately you are not a good fit for the role. 



List the editing software you use.



Tell me your typical turn around for an edit?



What is your internet upload speed?



Please put [Tiktok Shop Editor] in the title of your response so I know you read this fully. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



I watch every reel link from applicants who follow all of these steps. Please note, the length of time you have been an editor and resume is less important than your ability to quickly understand what I am looking for and your attention to small details to recreate a post. Excited to see your work!

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM)
description:
Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM)

Location: Remote (US hours)

About OpenCall 

OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager who can take ownership of our customer relationships and ensure our AI agents are delivering measurable, undeniable value to the medical and dental practices we serve.



About the role 

As a Customer Success Manager at OpenCall, you are the bridge between our multi-location healthcare customers and our engineering/prompt teams. You aren't just doing check-in calls and sending NPS surveys; you are actively managing onboardings, understanding the complexities of medical scheduling, and driving product adoption.

You will own the post-sales lifecycle. When a new clinic comes online, you will guide them through deployment, ensuring their intake forms, scheduling rules, and practice quirks are perfectly translated into our system. You will look for optimization and expansion opportunities, and work directly with our Agent Developers to push automation rates higher and drive up booking numbers.



Responsibilities

- Own the customer lifecycle: Manage the onboarding, adoption, and retention of our medical and dental group partners. You are their primary advocate and point of contact.

- Workflow translation: Work with practice administrators to understand their specific operational rules, edge cases, and EHR/PMS integrations, ensuring our deployment team configures an optimal agent.

- Data-driven optimization: Review real call data and metrics. If a specific objection-handling flow isn't working for a dental clinic in Ohio, you are the one who flags it, measures the drop-off in booking rates, and coordinates the fix.

- Drive retention and expansion: Prove the ROI of OpenCall every single month, enabling the customer to roll out additional locations. You will run monthly and quarterly reviews grounded in hard data: calls handled, hours saved, and appointments booked.

- Feedback loop: Act as the voice of the customer to our product and engineering teams. You will help prioritize feature requests and flag drift or friction in live deployments before the customer even notices.



What we're looking for

- You've managed complex customers and onboardings before. You have 6+ years of experience as a CSM in a B2B SaaS or HealthTech company

- Analytical and empirical. You don't just ask customers how they feel; you look at the dashboard. You are comfortable diving into the data to justify your recommendations.

- Deep empathy mixed with operational rigor. You stay organized when multiple projects are in flight. You understand that in healthcare workflows, a bad deployment costs real money for real practices, and you know how to manage expectations carefully.

- Exceptional communication. You can seamlessly translate highly technical AI concepts to a non-technical front-office manager, and then turn around and translate front-office operational chaos into clear requirements for our engineering team.

- Problem-solving mindset. You are proactive. When a customer is struggling, you don't just log a ticket—you dig in, listen to the failed call recordings, and come to the table with a proposed solution.



Preferred Qualifications

- 6+ years of direct customer success experience

- 4+ years of experience in healthcare operations, SaaS, or contact center technology.

- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Hubspot or a similar CRM	

- 4+ years of experience with medical/dental scheduling software and workflows, and you've seen how messy a front desk can get.

- 4+ years of experience working alongside technical teams (engineers, product managers, or AI developers) to iterate on a highly technical product.

- Prior demonstrated experience and success working with US companies during US business hours.





If you are interested in this role, please create a short video (<5 minutes) describing your most challenging customer onboarding and most challenging customer renewal. Include the following details:



- The company and customer you were working with

- The key stakeholders at the customer and their roles

- What was challenging about the onboarding and renewal

- What you did to address those challenges

title: TAKEOFF SPECIALIST
description:
NOW HIRING: Takeoff Specialist

 

Location: Philippines – Remote

Projects: U.S.-Based Residential Construction

Working Hours: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT)

 

We are looking for an experienced Construction Estimator / Takeoff Specialist to join our team and support residential construction projects throughout the United States.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of construction drawings, specifications, and wood stick-frame / light-frame construction, with experience preparing accurate material and quantity takeoffs.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare detailed material and quantity takeoffs from architectural and structural construction drawings.

• Review plans, specifications, details, and schedules to determine project requirements.

• Perform takeoffs for various construction scopes, including:

o Wood framing

o Lumber and sheathing

o Concrete and foundations

o Roofing

o Siding and exterior finishes

o Doors and windows

o Drywall and insulation

o Interior finishes

o Other residential construction materials

• Organize takeoff quantities and project information using Smartsheet.

• Use Bluebeam Revu for plan review, measurements, markups, and quantity takeoffs.

• Review and navigate Revit models and drawings as needed.

• Coordinate with our U.S.-based design and construction team regarding project requirements and takeoff clarifications.

• Maintain accurate and organized estimating records for each project.

 

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field.

• Minimum 2 years of experience estimating or performing takeoffs for construction projects.

• Strong ability to read, understand, and interpret architectural and structural drawings and specifications.

• Experience with U.S. residential construction is highly preferred.

• Experience working with wood stick framing / light-frame construction is preferred.

• Strong knowledge of construction materials, methods, and terminology.

• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on takeoff accuracy.

 

Software Requirements

Candidates must be proficient in:

• Bluebeam Revu

• Revit

Experience with additional estimating or construction management software is a plus.

 

What We’re Looking For
