title: Outbound Sales Representative
description:
C# REMOTE B2B SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE



## U.S. MARKET | PHILIPPINES-BASED



Compliance Solutions Occupational Training (CSOT) is a U.S.-based Environmental, Health, and Safety training company with more than 30 years of experience helping workers and organizations operate safely.



We provide online, instructor-led, virtual, and customized safety training. More than 500,000 professionals across the United States have completed CSOT training to meet regulatory requirements and return home safely every day.



## THE OPPORTUNITY



We are seeking experienced, Philippines-based Sales Development Representatives to speak with U.S. business professionals about their safety training needs.



This is a high-volume, 100% outbound calling opportunity for someone who communicates clearly and confidently in English, listens carefully, asks thoughtful questions, and can build trust over the telephone.



You will contact current customers and prospective customers in construction, manufacturing, environmental services, and related industries. Your goal will be to identify training needs, recommend relevant CSOT courses, complete eligible enrollments, and connect larger opportunities with an Account Executive.



This is a remote independent-contractor opportunity with an anticipated service capacity of up to 40 hours per week. Candidates must be available during agreed U.S. business-hour coverage.



## WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Work within a high-volume outreach model with a target of at least 120 outbound calls per day.

* Speak with safety managers, operations leaders, human resources professionals, and other business decision-makers.

* Ask discovery questions to identify immediate training requirements and longer-term safety-compliance needs.

* Promote upcoming courses and recommend training options that fit the customer’s situation.

* Complete eligible course enrollments and provide qualified handoffs to Account Executives for larger opportunities.

* Respond professionally to objections and continue conversations without relying entirely on a script.

* Maintain accurate customer records, notes, follow-up activities, and opportunity information in the CRM.

* Communicate with the U.S. sales team through chat, CRM tools, and video meetings.

* Provide agreed activity and results reporting.



## ENGLISH COMMUNICATION STANDARD



Successful candidates must demonstrate advanced professional English suitable for daily telephone conversations with U.S. business customers.



We are looking for:



* Clear, easily understood speech.

* Natural conversational pacing and appropriate emphasis.

* Strong listening comprehension.

* Professional business vocabulary.

* The ability to ask follow-up questions and respond spontaneously.

* Confidence explaining information in the candidate’s own words.

* Professional written communication for
s, CRM notes, and team messages.



Candidates are evaluated on clarity, comprehension, professionalism, and conversational effectiveness—not on having a particular accent.



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS



* At least one year of outbound B2B sales, lead-generation, or appointment-setting experience.

* Experience making daily outbound calls to U.S.-based business professionals.

* Experience building rapport, asking discovery questions, and matching customers with appropriate solutions.

* Previous experience closing sales or securing commitments by telephone.

* Ability to work during agreed U.S. business hours, which occur overnight in the Philippines.

* Experience using scripts as conversation guides while still sounding natural and responsive.

* Strong CRM discipline and accurate documentation habits.

* Ability to organize follow-up activities and manage multiple customer conversations.

* A dependable computer, professional-quality headset, quiet home workspace, and stable high-speed internet connection.

* Comfort using CRM systems, communication platforms, and other business software.



## THE STRONGEST CANDIDATES WILL BE



* Warm, confident, and professional on the telephone.

* Curious and comfortable asking thoughtful questions.

* Organized and consistent with customer follow-through.

* Coachable and able to apply feedback.

* Self-motivated and dependable.

* Goal-oriented without sacrificing the customer experience.

* Comfortable in a high-volume outbound environment.

* Interested in building customer relationships—not simply reading a script.



Experience in safety training, regulatory compliance, construction, manufacturing, environmental services, or a related industry is helpful but not required.



## COMPENSATION



* Hourly compensation plus sales commissions



Final compensation will be discussed before an offer is made. Candidates should understand how hourly compensation, bonuses, and commission are calculated before accepting the opportunity.



## HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



Success in this opportunity includes:



* Consistent outbound activity.

* Productive conversations with appropriate business contacts.

* Accurate CRM notes and reliable follow-up.

* Qualified opportunities and effective Account Executive handoffs.

* Course enrollments and sales results.

* Professional representation of CSOT.

* Clear, dependable communication with the sales team.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please review our website at 
 and
 the following:



1. Your current résumé.

2. A recording of the voice-test script below.

3. Confirmation that you have the required equipment, internet connection, and availability during U.S. business hours.



Applications submitted without both requested recordings will not be considered.



### SCRIPTED VOICE SAMPLE



“Hello, my name is [name], and I’m calling from Compliance Solutions Occupational Training. We have an upcoming forty-hour HAZWOPER open-enrollment class in Albuquerque, New Mexico.



This instructor-led course helps employees understand hazardous-waste regulations, workplace risks, and appropriate safety procedures. The class runs Monday through Thursday, and space is still available.



I’d like to learn whether anyone at your facility needs initial certification or refresher training. Would you be available for a brief conversation, or could you refer me to the person responsible for employee safety and compliance?”

title: Technical Project Manager  (Web/ Integrations Focus)
description:
APPLY HERE FOR PRIORITIZED RESUME REVIEW:





TECHNICAL WEB PROJECT MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



If you're the kind of person who enjoys bringing order to complex technical projects, thrives on keeping web initiatives moving, and can confidently bridge the gap between developers, designers, marketers, and clients, then the Technical Project Manager (Web & Integrations Focus) role may be the perfect fit for you.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

You'll lead technical web and integration projects that help clients achieve measurable business outcomes. From HubSpot CMS implementations and Shopify projects to API integrations and website migrations, you'll be responsible for driving projects from planning through delivery while keeping teams aligned, clients informed, and timelines on track.



This role is about creating clarity, removing obstacles, and ensuring successful project execution.



You'll work closely with developers, designers, marketers, and clients to translate technical requirements into actionable project plans and ensure high-quality outcomes throughout every phase of delivery.

At Campaign Creators, we believe growth happens when strategy, creativity, and genuine human connection come together. Our mission is simple: help organizations tell their story and create systems that attract the right audience, nurture meaningful relationships, and fuel sustainable revenue growth.



We partner with companies that are ready to scale but need a guide. They need someone who can simplify complexity, align technology with purpose, and build marketing and sales systems that actually work. Through data-driven insights, thoughtful automation, and full-funnel strategy, we turn scattered efforts into clear, measurable pathways for growth.



On the inside, we're a team that values curiosity, autonomy, and continuous improvement. We champion mastery, not perfection. We encourage bold ideas, celebrate collaboration, and believe that work is most fulfilling when it creates real impact for the clients we serve.



For more than a decade, Campaign Creators has been a trusted partner to businesses across industries, helping them connect more deeply with their customers and unlock new levels of performance.



RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Project Leadership

- Manage project timelines, scope, budgets, priorities, and resource allocation.

- Coordinate work across developers, designers, marketing technologists, clients, and external vendors.

- Track dependencies across connected systems and ensure successful integration delivery.

- Translate technical integration requirements into actionable project plans.



Communication & Documentation

- Serve as the bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Translate complex technical concepts into client-friendly communication.

- Maintain project documentation, workflows, technical requirements, change logs, and implementation records.

- Ensure visibility across all active projects through consistent project updates and reporting.

Manage projects using tools such as:

- Teamwork

- Figma

- BugHerd

- BrowserStack

- HubSpot

- Other web development and collaboration platforms as needed



What Will Be Required to Be Successful in the Role

- Strong project leadership and organizational skills.

- Ability to manage multiple technical projects simultaneously.

- Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to proactively identify risks and remove blockers.

- Highly resourceful and comfortable conducting independent research to resolve issues.

- Detail-oriented with excellent documentation habits.

- Ability to balance client expectations, project timelines, and technical requirements.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment.



Experience Required

- Proven experience managing technical web projects from start to finish.

- Intermediate to advanced HubSpot CMS experience.

- Experience managing Shopify implementations or other eCommerce platforms.

- Experience managing website migrations, custom themes, and third-party integrations.

- Experience managing API integration projects, including requirements gathering, data mapping, testing, and deployment.

- Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs, webhooks, authentication methods, and responsive web development.

- Familiarity with technical SEO, website performance optimization, and UX best practices.

- Experience coordinating developers, designers, marketers, and external vendors.

Preferred Technology Stack

- Figma

- APIs

- HTML

Ideal Candidate Summary

Success in this role looks like well-organized projects, clear communication, predictable delivery, high-quality web implementations, and clients who feel informed and confident throughout every stage of the project lifecycle.

title: Senior Financial Accountant/Revenue Controller
description:
About the Company



We are a growing U.S.-based music school generating approximately $1M in annual revenue with a team of roughly 30 employees.



Our core financial and operational systems include Opus1, Clover Connect, and QuickBooks Online. We are looking for an experienced accounting professional who can help us strengthen financial controls, reconcile revenue accurately, identify discrepancies, and improve the quality of our monthly financial reporting.



About the Role



We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Financial Accountant / Revenue Controller to oversee revenue reconciliation, investigate discrepancies between billing systems and bank deposits, maintain clean and accurate books, and provide reliable financial reporting.



This role requires someone who is comfortable digging into complicated transactions, tracing missing or misapplied funds, identifying patterns, and explaining findings clearly.



The right person will be highly analytical, organized, dependable, and comfortable working independently.



Key Responsibilities



Revenue Reconciliation & Bookkeeping



Perform monthly three-way reconciliations comparing:

Opus1 invoices and billing activity

Clover Connect merchant payouts

QuickBooks Online bank deposits

Identify and investigate missing funds, unapplied credits, merchant processing fees, refunds, payment discrepancies, and software rollovers.

Properly categorize software billing and merchant-processing fees within QuickBooks Online.

Maintain accurate and fully reconciled accounts month over month.



Financial Reporting & Analysis



Prepare draft monthly Profit & Loss statements by the 10th of each month.

Track month-over-month revenue trends.

Analyze changes in fixed and variable expenses.

Monitor net profit margins.

Prepare payroll-to-revenue reporting.

Monitor teacher compensation ratios against company targets.



Financial Investigation



Research discrepancies between customer invoices, merchant transactions, deposits, credits, refunds, and recorded revenue.

Trace transactions across multiple systems to determine where inconsistencies originate.

Clearly document findings and recommend corrective action when needed.



Tax & Year-End Support



Maintain clean, reconciled books throughout the year.

Organize financial records for year-end tax preparation.

Coordinate with the company’s U.S.-based tax CPA as needed to support timely filings.



Operational Financial Support



Identify recurring cost anomalies or unexpected expense increases.

Monitor software fees and merchant-processing expenses.

Identify patterns involving uncollected revenue, refunds, credits, or billing inconsistencies.

Provide useful financial information to support pricing, compensation, and operational decisions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

CPA designation preferred, but not required

Minimum 3 years of accounting experience

Experience working with U.S. accounting practices

Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

Experience with merchant-payment processing and bank reconciliation

Advanced Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

Strong proficiency with Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, and complex data matching

Demonstrated experience auditing or reconciling subscription billing, practice-management, CRM, or similar software platforms

Strong written and spoken English

Exceptional attention to detail

Ability to independently investigate financial discrepancies and explain findings clearly

Preferred Qualifications

Experience reconciling transactions across multiple financial platforms

Experience working with recurring billing or subscription-based businesses

Experience with merchant processors or payment gateways

Experience supporting U.S.-based small or mid-sized businesses

Experience identifying revenue leakage or payment-processing discrepancies

Experience preparing management-level financial reports

What Success Looks Like



The person in this role should be able to answer questions like:



What was billed?

What was actually collected?

What reached the bank?

Where did the difference go?



We are looking for someone who does more than maintain the books. We want someone who can find the story behind the numbers and identify when something does not add up.



How to Apply



Begin your application with:



Opus1 Reconciliation Found



In 2–3 sentences, describe a situation where you reconciled information between a billing system, payment gateway, accounting system, and/or bank account and discovered a financial discrepancy.



Please include:



Your resume

Your hourly rate

Your availability

Your experience with QuickBooks Online

Your experience with revenue reconciliation or payment-processing audits



We look forward to receiving your resume!

title: Xero Bookkeeper & Finance Operations Assistant
description:
Xero Bookkeeper & Finance Operations Assistant



Type: Full-time contractor

Hours: 40 hours per week, with regular overlap with Irish working hours

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience

Long-term role: Yes



About Us:



We’re an Irish accounting and finance advisory firm working with small and growing businesses.



We are building a modern, technology-led accounting practice using tools such as Xero, ClickUp, Slack, ChatGPT and other automation platforms to make accounting and finance work more efficient.



We are looking for a highly organised and reliable Xero Bookkeeper & Finance Operations Assistant to become a key part of our team.



This is not a generic virtual assistant role.



Your primary responsibility will be to help manage the day-to-day finance and accounting work for our clients, while also helping us maintain excellent internal processes and client workflows.



The right person will be someone who takes ownership of their work, pays close attention to detail and does not simply follow instructions blindly. If something does not look right, we want you to investigate it and raise it.



Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



* Maintaining bookkeeping records in Xero

* Completing bank and credit card reconciliations

* Processing and reviewing purchase invoices and expenses

* Assisting with accounts payable and accounts receivable

* Identifying missing or unusual transactions

* Preparing bookkeeping files for VAT returns and accountant review

* Assisting with month-end bookkeeping and reconciliations

* Maintaining supporting documentation and accounting records

* Following up with clients for missing invoices, receipts and other information

* Drafting and sending routine client
s

* Maintaining client tasks and deadlines within ClickUp

* Supporting the onboarding of new clients

* Setting up and maintaining client records and workflows

* Following PTB’s documented SOPs and checklists

* Helping improve and document processes where appropriate

* Identifying issues that require accountant review and escalating them clearly

* Supporting payroll and other recurring finance administration where required



As you develop in the role, there will be opportunities to take ownership of more client work and increasingly complex accounting tasks.



What We Are Looking For



Essential



* Strong practical bookkeeping experience

* Good working knowledge of Xero

* Experience completing bank reconciliations

* Understanding of basic accounting principles

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent English, including the confidence and ability to make phone calls to or on behalf of clients.

* Strong organisational skills

* Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines

* Ability to work independently

* Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

* Reliable internet connection and computer

* Suitable private workspace for handling confidential financial information



Highly Desirable



* Experience working within a UK or Irish accounting practice

* Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple clients

* Experience with VAT preparation

* Accounts payable and accounts receivable experience

* Payroll experience

* Month-end accounting experience

* Balance sheet reconciliations

* Experience communicating directly with clients

* Experience using ClickUp, Asana, 
 or similar task-management software

* Experience documenting SOPs and improving processes

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills



Irish accounting or tax experience is helpful but not essential. We can teach the Irish-specific elements of the role to someone with strong accounting fundamentals.



The Type of Person We Want



We care as much about how you work as what you already know.



A strong candidate will:



* Take ownership of tasks rather than waiting to be chased

* Notice when something does not make sense

* Investigate problems before escalating them

* Avoid guessing when they are unsure

* Clearly explain what they have found

* Escalate issues with context and, where possible, a proposed solution

* Follow processes accurately while identifying opportunities to improve them

* Communicate professionally with clients and colleagues

* Be dependable and consistent

* Enjoy learning new systems and becoming more efficient

* Be comfortable working in a technology-focused accounting firm



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of the team rather than simply complete assigned tasks.



Example of How We Expect You to Work



If you are reconciling a client’s accounts and discover a transaction where the correct accounting or VAT treatment is unclear, we would not expect you to guess.



We would expect you to:



1. Investigate the transaction and available supporting information.

2. Check whether the answer is covered by our existing procedures.

3. Gather the relevant information.

4. Clearly explain what you found.

5. Escalate it to the accountant where a judgement or technical decision is required.



Good judgement and communication are extremely important in this role.



Working With Technology



PTB actively uses technology and AI to improve how we work.



You should be comfortable learning and using tools such as:



* Xero

* ClickUp

* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets

* Google Workspace

* ChatGPT and other AI tools

* Accounting and workflow automation software



We are happy for team members to use AI tools appropriately to work more efficiently, provided confidential information is handled correctly and the final work is checked carefully.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position of approximately 40 hours per week.



As PTB is based in Ireland, you must be comfortable providing regular overlap with Irish business hours for team communication and client work.



The exact working schedule can be discussed with the successful candidate.



Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience and capability.



We are more interested in finding an exceptional person than simply finding the lowest-cost candidate.



There will be opportunities for increased responsibility, professional development and compensation growth for someone who performs strongly in the role.



How to Apply



Please send a short application covering:



1. Your current employment situation and availability.

2. Your expected monthly salary for a full-time role.

3. Your experience using Xero.

4. Whether you have worked for a UK or Irish accounting practice.

5. The approximate number of client accounts you have managed at one time.

6. The bookkeeping/accounting tasks you personally complete for those clients.

7. Your experience communicating directly with clients.

8. Your usual approach when you encounter an accounting transaction you are unsure how to process.

9. Your available working hours in Irish time.

10. Why you are interested in a long-term role with PTB.



Please keep your answers concise. We are more interested in your actual experience and how you approach your work than a lengthy cover letter.

title: Field Operations Coordinator
description:
FIELD OPERATIONS COORDINATOR

Garage Door Company (Pennsylvania, USA) | Full-Time | Long-Term | Night Shift



Some people can walk past a loose end. You are not one of them.



Somewhere in your last job there was a detail nobody else caught. A date that quietly moved. A number that did not match the other number. Something a customer said in passing that turned out to matter three weeks later. You noticed it. You probably fixed it. Almost nobody thanked you, and the people who benefited never knew it happened.



We are looking for exactly that person. And we intend to notice.



This is not a virtual assistant job. We are not hiring someone to take messages, update a spreadsheet, and wait for instructions. We are hiring the person who runs the operational heartbeat of a real American construction business, who talks to our customers and our vendors directly, who learns a genuine technical trade, and whose judgment we will rely on every single day.



Tomorrow morning a truck carrying two technicians and a nine thousand dollar garage door will pull into a driveway in Pennsylvania. Either that job is ready or it is not. Making sure it is ready, on roughly a hundred and thirty jobs at once, is your work.



Now the hard part.



BEFORE YOU GO ANY FURTHER



Our schedule is 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday.



That is 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM Manila time. This is a permanent night shift.



Please read that twice before reading anything else. Our customers answer their phones during their afternoon, and this role lives on the phone. There is no way around it.



If a permanent night shift does not fit your life, your health, or your family, please do not apply. We would rather you know now than three months from now. We are hiring someone to stay for years, not months.



Still with us? Good. Here is the real job.



WHO WE ARE



We sell, install, and service garage doors across Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, and New Jersey. Our customers are homeowners, business owners, custom home builders, and large construction firms. We started in 2024, we are growing fast, and we are building something we intend to be proud of.



Here is the part that matters more.



Our Field Operations Director is Joanna. She is Filipino. She joined this company remotely, exactly the way you would, and today she runs our entire field operation - estimating, scheduling, customer care, and a team of her own. She is the one who will hire you, train you, and work beside you every night. When we tell you there is a real future here, we are not making a promise. We are pointing at a person who already did it.



We are a small company, which means there is nowhere to hide and no reason to want to. You will know everyone by name and we will know yours. We will know when your kid has a program at school. You will know when Josh is out fighting a stuck torsion spring in ninety-five degree heat.



We are not a call center. You are not a resource. Nobody here is ever going to call you a VA.



WHAT IT IS ACTUALLY LIKE TO WORK HERE



We are going to be straight with you, because we would rather earn your trust than collect your application.



Some nights are hard. The pace is real, the phone is busy, and this is a night shift. We are not going to pretend any of that away.



And this is also a group of people who genuinely enjoy each other.



- You get paid on time. Every single time. You should never once have to wonder about it, and here you will not.

- When you make a mistake, and you will, we fix it together and move on. Nobody here gets humiliated over a bad day.

- When you catch something big, somebody says so out loud, by name, in front of the team. That happens a lot around here.

- We are on video together. We tell jokes. We ask about your family and we actually want to hear the answer.

- Ask questions. Ask a hundred of them. The only people who struggle here are the ones who go quiet.

- We want you to get better every year you are here, and we will pay attention to whether you are.



And here is the thing we actually believe, which shows up in our numbers: the way we treat each other is the way we end up treating our customers. You cannot fake warmth on the phone for eight hours a night if it is not real in the room first. Our builders and homeowners come back to us because they like us. That starts inside, with us, with you.



WHAT WE BELIEVE



We should tell you plainly who we are, because it is underneath everything above - we are people who take our Christian faith seriously in real life every day, not just at church on Sunday. Here is what that actually means, and you can hold us to all of it:



We tell the truth, especially when it costs us. If we made the mistake, we say we made the mistake - to each other, to our customers, and to you. We will not ask you to shade anything for anyone, ever.



We hold this company in trust. We do not really think we own it. We believe we are stewards of something that belongs to God, and that we will answer for how we treated the people inside it. That includes you.



Every person we deal with bears the image of God. The homeowner, the technician, the vendor rep having a terrible day, the customer who cannot pay his bill. Every one of them gets treated with dignity. Not because it is good business, though it is. Because it is true.



We work hard and we rest. We do not worship our work, and we do not want you to either. Your family is not a competing priority to us.



We will care about you as a person, not as a function. Your health, your household, your growth, your life outside these hours - those are real to us and we will ask about them.



We are not going to interrogate anyone about their faith - but we are not going to hide ours either. It is the reason we run this company the way we do, and if reading this made something in you say yes, we would very much like to meet you.



WHAT YOU ARE ACTUALLY MANAGING



Right now we have around 130 active jobs moving at once. Some are waiting on a permit. Some are waiting on a truck from our factory in Ohio. Some are scheduled three weeks out and nobody has confirmed the homeowner will be home. Your job is to know the true status of every one of them and to find the problem while it is still cheap to fix.



WHAT A REAL DAY LOOKS LIKE



You open the installation dashboard. Seventy-four active lines.



Four jobs are confirmed for next week, so you run the 10-Day Pre-Check on each. You call the homeowner: Is the driveway clear? Is the old opener staying or going? Will someone be home? Is the power on? She mentions offhand that they are pouring a new concrete slab that Friday. You just prevented a wasted truck, two idle technicians, and an angry customer.



A project manager at a builder texts asking where his doors are. The factory shows a four-week lead time and his delivery moved from the 1st to the 8th. You do not guess and you do not stall. You check the vendor delivery dashboard, confirm the load date, and call him back the same morning with a real answer, good news or bad. He starts trusting you. Six months from now he calls you first instead of calling our owner.



Tomorrow's install has an unanswered technical question about headroom on a 16-foot opening. That goes to our Field Services Manager, because it is a judgment call and he is the best in the region at making it. The homeowner who wants to move from Thursday to Friday? You handle that yourself, and you tell him what you did. Knowing the difference between those two is most of this job.



At 4:30 you write the End-of-Day report: what moved, what is stuck, what needs a decision tomorrow. The whole team reads it. Because of you, nobody starts the next morning guessing.



THE OTHER HALF OF THE JOB: YOU ARE THE FRONT DOOR



Everything above is about jobs we have already sold. The other half of your day is about the ones we have not sold yet.



All day, our phone rings, our text line buzzes, and our inbox fills with people we have never spoken to. A homeowner whose spring just broke and whose car is trapped inside the garage. A builder's project manager pricing eleven doors. A business owner whose dock door will not close.



You share that intake with our Field Operations Director. She cannot answer every call and message, and neither can you. That is exactly why it is shared. Whoever is free picks it up. There is no "that one is not mine."



Four things have to be true every single time:



1. A great first impression. For most of these people you are the first human contact they have with our company. Whether they ever call us back is d
 in the first fifteen seconds.



2. A knowledgeable answer, not a transfer. Not "let me have someone call you back." Over time you will learn our vendors, our product lines, door styles, colors, insulation options, openers, and what is realistic on lead times, well enough to genuinely help someone on the first call. You will not know any of this on day one. You will be expected to be genuinely good at it within a few months, and we will teach you.



3. Excellent detail collection. Door size, opening height, headroom, what is there now, what they want, the address, the timeline, and how to reach them. Every detail you fail to capture is a phone call someone has to make later, or an estimate that comes back wrong.



4. Prompt follow-through. Speed wins this business. The company that answers first and follows up first usually gets the job. A lead that sits until tomorrow is usually a lead somebody else already won.



WHAT YOU OWN



- Shared lead intake. Inbound calls, texts, and
s from people who have never contacted us before. Answered live wherever possible, captured completely, and routed the same day.

- Job readiness. The 10-Day and 1-Day Pre-Checks are yours. Confirm the site, access, measurements, customer, and expectations.

- The true pipeline picture. Every job's real status kept current in Housecall Pro. Not what it was last Tuesday. What it is right now.

- Materials and deliveries. Track what is ordered, what is confirmed, what is late. Chase it before anyone asks you about it.

- Customer communication. Phone,
, and text with homeowners, business owners, and project managers. Warm, clear, and honest, especially when the news is bad.

- Vendor and PM relationships. You will speak with the same factory reps and builder project managers weekly for years. Building genuine, professional relationships with them is one of the most valuable things you will do here.

- The End-of-Day report, every working day.

- Making the process better. We do not want someone who only follows the system. We want someone who runs it long enough to see exactly where it leaks, then says so and helps fix it. This is in the job description, not a bonus.



WHO THRIVES HERE



- Relentless follow-through. Organized under pressure, with forty open loops and the phone ringing.

- You notice things. A delivery date that shifted quietly. A note that contradicts another note. A customer who said "probably" when you needed "yes."

- You move before you are asked.

- Calm when it goes sideways. Doors get damaged in transit, permits get denied, weather happens. Gather facts, find the path, tell people early.

- Warm on the phone AND honest in the hard conversation. Being pleasant is not enough if the customer does not get the truth.

- You can hold your ground kindly. Sometimes a busy American project manager will push you for a date you do not have. The right answer is not to agree, and not to apologize your way out of it. It is to say clearly what you know, what you do not, and when you will come back with more, and then do it.

- You own mistakes fast. Everyone here makes them. The only unforgivable move is letting one hide until it gets expensive.

- You actually like people. Not tolerate them. Like them. The best person in this seat will end up with real friendships across two countries, and will be a little sad on a Friday.

- You want to be the person who knows the answer. Some people are content to take a message. You are not. You want to know enough about our products, our vendors, and our options that you can actually help a stranger on the first call, and it bothers you when you cannot.

- You want to get good at something. Garage doors are a real trade with real depth. You do not need to know any of it on day one. You do need to want to learn it, and to still be learning it in year three.



THIS JOB PROBABLY IS FOR YOU IF



- You would rather be crazy busy than slightly bored

- Your mind needs constant new creative challenges

- You see a problem to solve as a game, not a burden

- Your superpower is being on top of every detail

- You like projects, but you love the people behind them

- You never want to stop learning and growing

- Your dream is a team that becomes like family



THIS JOB IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF



- You want a quiet remote job with a predictable queue

- You need someone to tell you what to do next

- You get flustered when the plan changes twice in one afternoon

- Details feel tedious rather than satisfying

- You would rather be liked than be accurate

- You are looking for a second job to stack on top of another one

- The night shift is something you are hoping you can get used to



We would genuinely rather you figure that out now than four months in. So would you.



REQUIREMENTS



Required:

- Spoken English that is clear and immediately understood by American customers on the phone, including on speakerphone, from a noisy construction site, and at 3:00 AM your time

- Strong written English. Clean, specific, professional messages with correct detail

- Comfortable making outbound calls all day, including calls the other person did not ask for

- Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, backup power, and a quiet workspace

- Available for the full 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern shift, Monday to Friday

- Genuine willingness to learn a technical trade



Strongly preferred:

- Experience coordinating projects with real deadlines and multiple moving parts

- Background in construction, engineering, home services, logistics, dispatch, or field service

- Housecall Pro or similar field service software

- Prior experience working directly with American customers by phone

- Experience taking inbound calls from brand-new customers, not only from accounts you already knew



HOW WE HIRE



We are telling you this up front because we are asking for real time from you.



1. Application. The three questions below, plus two short voice recordings.

2. Reality Pack. If we like your answers, we send you our actual installation dashboard, our real process flows, and the scorecard you would be measured against. Look at it hard. Some people opt out here, and that is a good outcome for everyone.

3. Paid work sample. Real jobs, real decisions, about two hours. We pay for your time either way.

4. Live conversations, unscripted.

5. Paid trial period before either of us commits long-term.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your reply with the word HEADROOM so we know you read this far. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Then send us all four items below. We review applications that are complete. If any of the four is missing, we will not be able to consider you - not because we are being strict for its own sake, but because these four things are how we can tell the difference between people, and we would rather not guess about you.



1. Tell us about the last time something fell through the cracks on your watch. What happened, who found it, and what did you change afterward?



2. Describe a time you followed the process exactly and it turned out to be the wrong call.



3. What is a tracker, checklist, or system you built yourself in a previous job because the existing one was not good enough? Attach it or link it if you still have it.



4. Record TWO short unscripted voice messages - two separate recordings, about a minute each - and share the links (Google Drive, Vocaroo, or similar). Do not write scripts first. Just record them. Please label which is which.



Recording 1: "A customer's garage door delivery has been delayed by two weeks and it is not our fault. Call them and tell them."



Recording 2: "A homeowner you have never spoken to calls. Her garage door spring broke this morning and her car is stuck inside. Answer the phone." In this recording, say what you would say to her and what you would need to find out.



We want both recordings spoken, not written. We are listening for how you sound to a real customer, which is something we cannot hear on paper.



BEFORE YOU HIT SEND, CHECK



- Does your message start with the word HEADROOM?

- Did you answer all three questions?

- Did you include TWO recording links, labeled 1 and 2?

- Can we actually open your links? Please check the sharing permissions.



Please answer honestly rather than impressively. We read these closely and we can tell the difference.



If you read all of this and felt your pulse pick up a little with excitement - the pipeline, the puzzle, the phone, the people - then we would really like to meet you.



Come help us make the day predictable and boring for the field team and the customer, in the best possible way. And come have some crazy unpredictable fun with us while we do it.

title: Success Specialist/ Team Leader/ Supervisor / Unit Manager / Operations Manager
description:
The Role



This seat owns the remote team member after training ends.



Once someone is placed and working, the risk changes shape. It stops being about skill and starts being about engagement, accountability, communication, and consistency. Problems in this phase rarely announce themselves — they show up as a slightly slower response, a missed check-in, a pattern of small absences, a client who has gone quiet. The Success Specialist is the person who notices early and acts before it becomes a departure or a lost account.



You are not a manager and you are not a trainer. You are the early warning system and the coordination point. You see the pattern, you organize the response, and you make sure the follow-through actually happens.



What This Seat Owns



Engagement health and monitoring



Monitor engagement health, accountability, attendance patterns, and professional standards

Identify early warning signs of disengagement, performance decline, communication gaps, or retention risk

Monitor completion of required acknowledgments, compliance activities, and ongoing success requirements



Structured contact



Conduct structured check-ins after placement and throughout the active engagement

Reinforce standards for dependability, communication, no-surprises expectations, and professional conduct

Reinforce AI readiness, tool readiness, communication standards, and professional expectations



Intervention and follow-through



Coordinate coaching and corrective support where intervention is required

Track recurring issues and ensure clear follow-through to resolution

Maintain accurate success notes, risk indicators, intervention history, and follow-up actions



Coordination and escalation



Coordinate with Training when someone requires retraining or skill reinforcement

Coordinate with Client Success when an issue may affect the client relationship

Escalate serious or unresolved risks to the Head of Success



Development and retention



Support engagement, recognition, development, and retention initiatives

Identify recurring patterns and recommend improvements to training or success processes

Boundary of the Seat



This seat owns the remote team member after training.



It does not own initial training delivery, the client relationship, company-wide operations, or overall process improvement. Where those areas are affected, the Success Specialist coordinates with the accountable team or escalates to the Head of Success rather than acting unilaterally.



Non-Negotiables



Pattern recognition, not i
 response. You can look across attendance, responsiveness, tone, and output and see a trend forming before it becomes a problem. Reacting only when something breaks is not this role.



Difficult conversations without escalation of tone. You can raise a concern directly, stay neutral, and keep the conversation focused on behavior, expectations, and agreed actions.



Documentation discipline. Notes, risk indicators, intervention history, and follow-up actions are current and accurate. If it is not written down, it did not happen — and it cannot be escalated credibly.



Follow-through to closure. You do not hand off a concern and assume it resolved. You track it until there is a documented outcome.



Judgment on what to escalate. You know the difference between something you coordinate and something the Head of Success needs to see immediately. Both over-escalating and sitting on risk are failures.



Clear, direct written and spoken English. You will document, communicate across departments, and hold structured conversations.



Neutral framing. Coaching and documentation address behavior, performance, and clarity of expectations — not personality labels or psychological profiling.



Strong Advantages





Experience in employee relations, HR business partnering, account management, or a similar retention-facing role

Background in a remote or offshore delivery environment

Prior experience running structured check-in or engagement programs at scale

Comfort working across systems: dashboards, trackers, CRM or HRIS records

Practical AI and tool fluency in your own work



If you come from a BPO management background — team lead, operations manager, or people manager — you are welcome to apply. The monitoring, coaching, escalation, and documentation habits built in that environment translate directly to this seat.



Not a Fit If



You avoid raising concerns until they become undeniable

You see documentation as paperwork rather than as the evidence base for decisions

You want to own performance management outcomes and disciplinary authority

You need every situation to have a defined script





Success Measures

Horizon Measure

30 days Check-in cadence running consistently; notes and risk indicators current

90 days Early warning signs identified and raised before they surface from the client side

180 days Every intervention has a documented outcome; recurring patterns compiled and recommended upstream

Ongoing Retention risk is known and being worked, not discovered after the fact



How to Apply:



Share resume link

Share intro video about your background in coaching.

title: Marketing & SEO Manager — GoHighLevel + Google Ads (US Home Service)
description:
Own the marketing engine that turns a stranger with a burst pipe at 10:30 PM into a paid invoice.



We are a residential plumbing and hvac company in New Jersey. We run on GoHighLevel and Housecall Pro and we spend real money on leads every month. We are not looking for someone to "do marketing." We need one person who owns SEO, GoHighLevel automation, and paid ads end to end, and who is measured on booked jobs.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



SEO and content (about 40%). Keyword research for local plumbing and HVAC intent. Writing and publishing long-form blog articles yourself. On-page work, internal linking, cannibalization. Technical SEO and indexation. Google Business Profile and local pack. Owning Google Search Console and acting on what it says.



GoHighLevel automation (about 30%). Building SMS and
 campaigns from scratch: segmentation, opt-in and compliance, sending number setup, workflow logic, exit conditions, testing before launch. Speed to lead. Missed-call text-back, database reactivation, review requests, seasonal campaigns. Maintaining the GoHighLevel to Housecall Pro integration.



Paid ads (about 20%). Google Ads and Local Services Ads, including LSA verification and insurance compliance. Meta and other lead sources. Call tracking and attribution.



Reporting (about 10%). One weekly report that follows the money: leads, contacted, booked, showed, sold, revenue, cost per booked job. Not click-through rates.



WHAT YOU'RE WALKING INTO



We would rather you know now. Search Console shows far more pages not indexed than indexed. Our Local Services Ads have been offline since late June on an insurance verification lapse. Our Google Ads cost per click is around $13 and we are losing impression share on core terms. We have blog articles written but never published. Our SMS system is halted after a workflow error sent duplicate texts and triggered a carrier warning.



If you can look at that list and tell us which one you would fix first and why, we want to talk to you.



HOW WE WORK - READ THIS CAREFULLY



1. Nothing sends without written approval. Mass SMS,
 blasts, ad launches, budget changes. Every time.

2. You test before you send. Test contacts, a small controlled segment, verify exit conditions, then scale. A campaign that texts the same customer twice is worse than one that never ran.

3. You report on a fixed schedule without being asked. A short end-of-day note daily, and one written report every Friday.



Skill is table stakes. Reliability is what we are actually hiring for.



YOU MUST HAVE



3+ years hands-on GoHighLevel, built in weekly. 2+ years SEO for local or service businesses with published content that ranked and real Search Console work. Native-level written English, because you will write blogs, ad copy and SMS. Google Ads and LSA experience with real budget. Ability to work independently and report without being chased.



Nice to have: Housecall Pro or ServiceTitan, Zapier or Make, landing page builders, AI chatbot setup in GoHighLevel.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



Full time, 40 hours per week. $400 USD per week, paid weekly. Minimum 4 hours overlap with US Eastern Time, 9 AM to 1 PM EST.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word PIPEWRENCH so we know you read this, then answer three things. Short answers are fine. Real numbers beat long paragraphs.



1. Which problem from the list above would you fix first, and why that one?

2. Tell us about one campaign, automation or SEO project you built and the actual result it produced. Give us the number.

3. What is your process for making sure a mass SMS does not go out twice to the same person, or go out before it is approved?



Shortlisted candidates get a longer written questionnaire, then a call where you share your screen and walk us through a live GoHighLevel account and a live Search Console property. Please have those ready.

title: Dispatch Operations Specialist
description:
We’re hiring our first dedicated Dispatcher to support our growing operations, particularly on a network of autonomous vehicles and food-delivery robots across U.S. markets. You’ll take ownership of day-to-day dispatch including monitoring live fleet operations, coordinating with field teams, troubleshooting issues as they happen, and helping build dispatch workflows that will support the operation as it scales. 



You’ll be working across multiple systems and communication channels, keeping track of what’s happening across different markets and jumping in when something needs attention. You’ll work closely with field operators and internal teams, make quick calls when issues come up, and speak directly with customers when needed. 



This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable making quick decisions, switching between different tools, and working with both internal teams and external customers. You’ll be working closely with U.S.-based field teams every shift, so previous experience supporting U.S. operations remotely is a strong plus. Since this function is still being built, you’ll also have a real opportunity to help shape the workflows, escalation paths, and processes that the team will use as it grows.



What You'll Do

- Monitor fleet activity and alert channels across multiple platforms and markets, tracking robot and vehicle locations, battery levels, active tasks, and delivery status.

- Own operational issues through resolution by identifying and prioritizing issues as they arise, including stalled or  immobilized robots, unsafe conditions, missed tasks, and deliveries that fall off schedule.

- Contact the assigned field operator to resolve the issue, and follow established escalation procedures when they do not respond within the required timeframe.

- Coordinate backup coverage when the assigned operator is unavailable so that fleet operations continue without interruption.

- Continuously triage incoming alerts, messages, and fleet data, determining what requires immediate action and what can be handled through normal workflows.

- Prioritize and coordinate field service activity across markets, including battery swaps, robot recoveries, fleet interventions, and other service stops.

- Handle calls from drivers and supervisors on active runs who are unable to locate a delivery address or reach a customer, and resolve the issue on their behalf.

- Contact customers directly to confirm delivery locations, obtain access instructions, or complete a drop off.

- Document each i
, the actions taken, and any details relevant to future operations - such as gate codes, difficult access points, and recurring problem locations - and help pinpoint recurring patterns that can improve future workflows and customer technology.

- Contribute to the development of dispatch procedures, escalation paths, and operational documentation as the operation grows.

- Work across multiple customer platforms, dashboards, Slack channels, and internal tools, quickly building context even when information is spread across different systems.



What We're Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in dispatch, logistics, fleet operations, transportation, field operations, or another fast-moving operations environment.

- At least 1 year of experience working directly with a startup is highly preferred

- Experience supporting U.S.-based companies, customers, drivers, operators, or field teams, preferably in a remote or offshore setup.

- Hands-on experience coordinating drivers, field workers, technicians, couriers, vehicles, deliveries, or other moving resources.

- Strong real-time problem-solving skills. You can assess a situation quickly, figure out what needs to happen, and take action without waiting to be told every step.

- Comfortable handling multiple tasks, systems, and communication channels at the same time, as well as piecing together information across multiple tools when troubleshooting an issue.

- Confident in communicating with customers, drivers, operators, and internal teams, including people you may be interacting with for the first time.

- Comfortable making outbound calls and speaking with unfamiliar customers, drivers, and operators in real time.

- Strong, natural English communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Strong documentation skills with the ability to clearly capture what happened, what was done, and what needs to happen next.

- Comfortable working with technology and learning unfamiliar platforms quickly.

- Able to stay calm, organized, and responsive when several time-sensitive issues happen at once.

- Comfortable working in a startup environment where processes and tools are still evolving.

- Available to work U.S.-aligned hours, including weekends or other coverage periods when needed.

- Reliable internet connection and a dependable work-from-home setup.



Salary and Benefits:

- Base salary: 55,000 PHP per month

- Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

- 100% Work From Home



Application Instructions

Please send your resume link using a publicly accessible PDF from Google Drive. Make sure it is a direct file link (not a folder or Google Doc).

Links from Dropbox, OneDrive, OnlineJobs, or other similar platforms, as well as non-direct file links, may not be reviewed by our Talent Team.

About Us:

We specialize in transforming vacation rentals into high-performing assets across national markets, currently anchored in the Smoky Mountains of Tennessee. 



Our culture is built on the "family-style" values of kindness and leadership, yet we operate with the precision and scalability of a high-growth tech company. We are a lean, execution-focused team that rejects micro-management in favor of individual ownership, and we are looking for a visionary partner to help us build the systems that will support our goals.



Accountability:

title: Paid Ads & Lead Generation Manager
description:
# Ads & Lead Generation Manager



**Company:** Refined Touch Media

**Position:** Ads & Lead Generation Manager

**Location:** Remote



## About the Role



Refined Touch Media is looking for an **Ads & Lead Generation Manager** who can understand, diagnose, build, and improve lead-generation campaigns across **Meta Ads and Google Ads**.



This is not a position for someone who simply launches campaigns, follows instructions, and reports numbers.



We're looking for someone who can **think strategically**.



You should be able to look at a campaign, understand what is happening, identify where performance may be breaking down, and recommend what should happen next.



That includes understanding the relationship between:



* Targeting and audience selection

* Retargeting

* Offers and messaging

* Ad creative

* Landing pages and lead forms

* Cost per lead

* Lead quality

* Conversion tracking

* Campaign structure

* Testing and optimization



The right person will help lead both the **strategy and execution** behind Google and Meta advertising campaigns for Refined Touch Media and our clients.



## Your Goal



Your goal is simple:



**Take paid advertising execution and optimization off the owner's plate while improving the quality and consistency of the leads our campaigns generate.**



We don't just want more leads.



We want to understand **who we're reaching, why they're responding, what they're doing after they respond, and how we can continuously improve campaign performance.**



## Key Responsibilities



### Campaign Strategy & Development



* Develop lead-generation strategies based on the client's business, audience, offer, market, and goals

* Build and manage campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads

* Research and develop appropriate targeting strategies

* Develop prospecting and retargeting campaigns

* Recommend campaign structures, budgets, offers, and testing strategies

* Identify opportunities to improve existing campaigns rather than simply maintaining them



### Campaign Optimization



Regularly analyze campaign performance and determine:



* What is working

* What isn't working

* Why performance may be changing

* What should be tested next

* Where budget should be increased, decreased, or reallocated



Optimization may include:



* Audiences

* Keywords

* Search terms

* Locations

* Placements

* Creative

* Copy

* Offers

* Landing pages

* Lead forms

* Retargeting

* Bidding strategies

* Campaign structure



We expect you to **diagnose before making changes**.



### Targeting & Retargeting



You should have a strong understanding of how to reach the right audience at different stages of the customer journey.



This includes experience with:



* Cold audience targeting

* Keyword and search-intent targeting

* Custom audiences

* Website visitor retargeting

* Customer list audiences

* Lookalike or similar audience strategies where appropriate

* Engagement retargeting

* Campaign exclusions

* Geographic targeting

* Audience segmentation



You should understand that targeting is more than choosing demographics. The goal is to understand **intent, behavior, awareness, and where someone is in the buying process.**



### Lead Quality



Success will not be measured solely by generating the cheapest possible lead.



A $15 lead that never answers the phone isn't necessarily better than a $40 lead that becomes a customer.



You should be comfortable evaluating campaign performance beyond surface-level metrics and helping us determine whether campaigns are attracting the **right opportunities for our clients.**



### Tracking & Reporting



* Monitor CPL, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, ROAS and other relevant metrics

* Verify that conversion tracking is functioning properly

* Help identify discrepancies between advertising-platform data and actual leads

* Communicate campaign performance clearly

* Provide recommendations rather than simply sending reports

* Track tests and document what was changed and why



## Creative Collaboration



You will work alongside our creative and marketing team.



You are **not expected to personally create every video, graphic, or landing page**, but you should be able to recognize when creative or messaging may be limiting campaign performance.



For example:



Instead of saying:



> "We need new ads."



We want someone capable of saying:



> "This audience is generating clicks, but conversion rates are low. I recommend testing a stronger problem-focused hook and a new landing page headline before increasing the budget."



Your ability to communicate **what creative is needed and why** is important.



## What We're Looking For



* Proven experience managing Meta Ads

* Proven experience managing Google Ads

* Experience with lead-generation campaigns

* Strong understanding of targeting and retargeting

* Experience diagnosing underperforming campaigns

* Understanding of conversion tracking

* Understanding of landing-page and lead-form conversion principles

* Ability to interpret campaign data and turn it into actionable recommendations

* Strong written and verbal communication

* Ability to manage multiple client accounts

* Organized and dependable

* Comfortable working independently



## Who Excites Us?



We're looking for someone who is:



**Proactive.**

You identify problems and opportunities without waiting for someone to tell you what to do.



**Analytical.**

You don't make campaign changes because something "feels wrong." You use data, context, and testing.



**Curious.**

When performance changes, your first instinct is to figure out why.



**Strategic.**

You understand that successful advertising involves more than Ads Manager. Audience, offer, creative, landing page, follow-up, and sales process all influence results.



**Accountable.**

If something isn't performing, you communicate it and develop a plan to improve it.



**Collaborative.**

You can work with strategists, designers, video editors, copywriters, and clients to improve results.



## How You'll Benefit



**Trust-Based Environment**

We care about performance, communication, and completed work rather than micromanaging your day.



**Flexible Working Hours**

Manage your schedule while remaining available for agreed-upon meetings, communication, and deadlines.



**Creative Support**

You won't be expected to solve every creative problem yourself. You'll have the ability to communicate what assets or messaging you believe campaigns need.



**Performance Reviews**

Regular performance reviews with opportunities for increased responsibility and incentives based on performance.



**Growth Opportunity**

We're building our advertising systems as Refined Touch Media grows. The right person has an opportunity to take increasing ownership of our paid acquisition department.



# How to Apply



Along with your resume and portfolio, **please answer the following questions.**



Generic or AI-generated answers will not help us understand your experience. We want to understand how **you actually think about campaigns.**



### 1. Campaign Diagnosis



A Meta lead-generation campaign has been running successfully for two months. Cost per lead suddenly increases by 60% over the next three weeks.



**Walk us through your process for diagnosing the problem before making changes.**



What would you look at first, second, and third?



### 2. Lead Quality



A campaign is producing a high volume of inexpensive leads, but the client's sales team says most leads aren't answering their phones or aren't qualified.



**How would you investigate and improve the campaign?**



### 3. Targeting



Describe your process for determining who should be targeted when launching a new Meta or Google Ads campaign for a service-based business.



What information do you want before building the campaign?



### 4. Retargeting



Explain how you approach retargeting.



What audiences would you consider creating, and how would your messaging change between someone who has never heard of the company and someone who has already visited the website or engaged with an ad?



### 5. Optimization



Once a campaign is live, **what is your process for improving it?**



Explain how you d
:



* What to test

* When to make changes

* When to leave something alone

* When to increase budget

* When to pause an ad, audience, keyword, or campaign



### 6. Creative Strategy



If you believe poor creative is hurting campaign performance, how would you communicate what you need from our creative team?



Provide an example of the type of creative recommendation or brief you would give them.



### 7. Experience



Please provide examples of campaigns you've personally managed, including where possible:



* Platform

* Industry

* Advertising spend

* Campaign objective

* Cost per lead or acquisition

* What you changed

* Result after your changes



We care less about impressive screenshots and more about understanding **what you personally contributed to the result.**



## Final Note



We're not looking for someone who knows where all the buttons are in Meta and Google.



We're looking for someone who understands **why they're pressing them.**



If you enjoy analyzing campaigns, testing ideas, solving problems, and continuously finding ways to generate better opportunities for businesses, we'd like to hear from you.

Strong communication skills.

Reliable, proactive, and accountable.

Competitive monthly salary.

Clear systems and processes.

Supportive team environment.

Opportunities for growth as the company continues to expand.

title: Marketing Designer
description:
FlipSwitch Apparel Systems (FSA) helps gyms and fitness businesses run branded engagement campaigns, done-for-you online stores, and member participation programs. We're looking for a Marketing Content Designer to multiply the output of our Marketing Manager by turning campaign concepts into finished marketing assets, fast.



This is NOT a branding or creative-direction role. Direction, strategy, and messaging are already provided. We need someone who can execute quickly, consistently, and with good taste using templates, systems, and existing brand guidelines.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:



Static graphics (this is the core of the role):
 headers, social posts,
/Meta ad creative, Shopify banners, product mockups

Execute from a brief, not invent strategy: pull angles, hooks, and visual direction from what's provided

Fast turnaround: same-day or next-day on standard requests

Take revisions without hand-holding: incorporate feedback directly

Basic video is a bonus, not required to start: simple template-based edits (15-30 second Reels-style cuts) are a plus, but this role is 99% static for now



TOOLS YOU SHOULD KNOW:



Canva or Adobe Express (primary, daily use)

Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator (editing, not from-scratch design)

Bonus, not required: CapCut or Adobe Premiere Rush



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



Speed: you can turn around a brief same-day or next-day, not week-later

Reliability: you show up, communicate, and hit deadlines without chasing

Coachability: you take direction well and don't need creative control to do good work

Taste: your output looks clean and professional even when working from templates



WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR:



A brand designer building identity systems from scratch

A professional videographer or motion graphics specialist

Someone who needs extensive creative freedom to produce good work



HOW THIS ROLE FITS IN:

You'll report to and take direction from our Marketing Manager. Briefs will include the concept, message, and reference examples. Your job is execution, not concepting.



TEST PROJECT (required before hire):

Before hiring, we run a short test project: two posts and one Canva template. Part of what we're testing is whether you understand the nuance between our B2B and B2C audiences, since that distinction matters a lot in how we communicate. Full details provided if you move forward.

title: Short form Editor
description:
# Short-Form Video Editor



Company:** ASAP Marketing

Position:** Short-Form Video Editor

Type:** PART TIME (open to full time) / Remote



#About ASAP Marketing



ASAP Marketing is a fast-paced social media and content agency working with brands across a variety of industries. We specialize in producing high-volume, engaging short-form content designed for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other social channels.



We're looking for an experienced Short-Form Video Editor to join our growing creative team.



The Role



As a Short-Form Video Editor, you'll be responsible for turning raw footage, UGC, brand assets, and creative concepts into polished, engaging vertical videos.



You'll work closely with our Social Media Managers, UGC Coordinators, General Manager, and other members of our creative team to ensure content is edited accurately, efficiently, and delivered on schedule.



This is a high-volume editing position. Many of the videos we produce are relatively straightforward, but we work with multiple brands and produce a significant amount of content every month.



We're looking for someone who can maintain quality while working quickly, consistently, and efficiently.



Responsibilities



Edit high volumes of short-form vertical video content in 9:16 format

* Create content primarily for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

* Turn raw footage and UGC into polished, social-ready video

* Coordinate with Social Media Managers and UGC Coordinators to ensure all necessary footage and assets are available

* Add captions, graphics, sound effects, music, transitions, B-roll, and other elements where appropriate

* Create strong hooks within the opening seconds of a video

* Understand and implement editing techniques designed to improve viewer retention and watch time

* Effectively use risers, pattern interrupts, pacing, sound design, cuts, zooms, B-roll, and visual hooks

* Maintain each client's individual editing style and brand identity

* Organize project files and exported content properly

* Complete revisions quickly when requested

* Manage multiple brands and projects simultaneously

* Consistently meet deadlines and expected editing output

* Communicate proactively with the team if footage, assets, instructions, or information are missing



What We're Looking For



Experience working for a social media agency, UGC agency, content agency, or with multiple brands simultaneously is a major advantage.



Editing Software



Experience with professional editing software such as:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve (Preferably DaVinci Resolve)



We're less concerned about which software you use and more concerned about the quality, speed, and consistency of your work.



What Success Looks Like:



This role is not about spending an entire day perfecting one video.



We operate in a high-volume environment, so the ideal editor understands how to balance quality with efficiency.



A successful editor at ASAP will be able to:



* Produce a high number of quality edits consistently

* Meet deadlines without sacrificing attention to detail

* Understand the intended style without excessive back-and-forth

* Identify opportunities to improve hooks, pacing, and retention

* Keep projects organized across multiple brands

* Communicate effectively with the rest of the content team

* Become faster and more efficient as they learn our clients and systems



 How to Apply



**A portfolio is REQUIRED.**



Please submit:



1. Your portfolio or examples of previous short-form editing work

2. The editing software you primarily use

3. Your current availability

4. A short introduction Video explaining your experience with short-form social media editing and why you think you would be a good fit for our team 



**Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.**



We're specifically interested in seeing examples of TikToks, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, UGC advertisements, talking-head videos, and other vertical short-form content.



If you're a fast, reliable editor who understands social media and enjoys producing great content at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Trainer WFH/Remote
description:
The Role



The Trainer owns learning execution and readiness for every remote team member entering the company and for every internal learning program we run.



This seat exists to make sure that when someone moves forward, they are actually ready — not just scheduled, not just attended, not just marked complete. You run the sessions, you assess against the standard, and you say clearly when someone is not there yet.



You execute the curriculum set under the Success strategy. You do not design the strategy, but you are the person closest to the trainees, so you are the first to see where the curriculum is failing and the one expected to surface it.



What This Seat Owns



Onboarding and orientation



Facilitate onboarding and orientation for new remote team members

Deliver structured internal training programs and required learning sessions

Execute the training curriculum and materials established under the Success strategy



Readiness and assessment



Assess trainee readiness against defined standards before progression

Identify training gaps and escalate readiness concerns to the Head of Success

Surface recurring trainee weaknesses that may require curriculum improvement



Records and tracking



Track training attendance, participation, completion, and certification

Maintain accurate training records, certification status, and completion data



Coordination



Coordinate training schedules, sessions, assessments, and trainee communications

Support post-training transition and ensure required handoff information is complete



Standards and materials



Support AI readiness, tool readiness, communication standards, and professional expectations

Maintain and update training materials based on approved process or policy changes

Boundary of the Seat



The Trainer owns learning execution and readiness.



The Trainer does not own long-term performance management of remote team members, company-wide process improvement, or the overall client relationship. Where those areas are affected, the Trainer raises it to the Head of Success rather than acting on it directly.



Non-Negotiables



Facilitation capability. You can run a live session with a group, hold attention, manage questions, and keep to time. You have done this repeatedly, not occasionally.



Assessment discipline. You can evaluate someone against a written standard and give an honest result, including when the answer is "not yet ready." Passing people through to avoid discomfort is the single fastest way to fail in this seat.



Records accuracy. Attendance, completion, and certification data must be correct and current at all times. This data drives progression decisions and client-facing commitments.



Clear, direct communication. Written and spoken English at a professional standard. You will communicate with trainees, with the Head of Success, and across departments during handoff.



Coordination reliability. Schedules, invites, materials, and assessments happen without being chased. This seat is a dependency for multiple teams.



Practical AI and tool fluency. You use AI tools in your own work and can teach others to use them properly, including where they should not be used.



Feedback without judgment language. Coaching and assessment are framed around behavior, performance, and clarity of expectations — not personality, labels, or profiling.



Strong Advantages



Prior experience training or onboarding staff in a remote or offshore delivery environment

Instructional design or curriculum maintenance exposure

Familiarity with US client working norms and cross-cultural communication expectations

Experience working inside an LMS or portal-based training system with completion tracking

Background in operations, client service, or a delivery role before moving into training





Not a Fit If

You want to own strategy and curriculum design rather than execute and improve it

You are uncomfortable telling someone they have not met the standard

You treat training records as administrative overhead rather than as the output of the role

You need to be reminded of your own schedule





Success Measures

Horizon Measure

30 days Running scheduled sessions independently; records current and accurate

90 days Readiness assessments applied consistently against the defined standard; gaps escalated with evidence

180 days Handoff information complete on every transition; recurring trainee weaknesses documented and raised for curriculum review





How to Apply:



Share your resume and intro video telling me why you are a perfect fit for this role.

Strong hands-on experience managing an established Shopify store.

Experience creating and updating landing pages and product pages with strong mobile responsiveness.

Excellent attention to detail, written English, organization, and proactive communication.

Preferred Experience

title: Creative Project Manager & Design Operations Specialist
description:
Role overview: 

You are the operational backbone of a small creative studio. You own client communication, project flow, and quality control, and you execute design work directly when the primary designer is unavailable. The founder’s name is on every deliverable. Your job is to make sure nothing leaves the studio that the founder would not proudly sign.



Client Communication & Proactive Reporting

• Acknowledge every client request quickly with a clear, realistic timeline

Project Management
