• Every deliverable is verified before it ships: kerning, spacing, alignment, weight consistency, resolution, export quality, copy accuracy

• When modifying existing brand assets, work from and verify against the source file. Never repurpose an old asset as new work

• A 5-minute edit gets the same precision as a full project



Direct Design Execution

• The primary designer works async off-hours. When time-sensitive requests land, you execute them yourself to full professional standard: logo lockups, typography adjustments, layout corrections, production edits

• If a request exceeds your skill level, say so immediately and set expectations. Never attempt-and-ship



Admin & Organization

• Draft scopes of work from provided formulas, track approvals, send W-9s and documents

• Maintain clean Drive structure and naming conventions

Tools: ClickUp, Google Drive, Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Canva,

Required skills

LSAT Unplugged is a US-based LSAT coaching and law school admissions company. We've been helping students raise their test scores since 2005. We run lean: a small team, a lot of automation, and systems that need to keep working while we focus on students.



**The role**



You'll be our hands-on tech assistant, working directly with our founder and supporting our tech lead and operations manager. This isn't a build-from-scratch engineering role. You're the person who keeps our marketing and operations machine running: setting up
 campaigns, updating sales pages, fixing the automation that broke, and catching problems before students notice them.



Most tasks are small and specific. A typical week: schedule a launch
 sequence, swap testimonials on a checkout page, figure out why a lead got the wrong text message, update our automations library so the next person can see how things work.



**Hard requirement: GoHighLevel**



You must already know GoHighLevel well. Funnels, workflows, calendars, products,
 and SMS. Not "I watched some tutorials." Not "I can learn it fast." You've built in it, broken things in it, and fixed them. This is the tool you'll live in, and we don't have time to teach it. If GHL isn't on your resume, this role isn't for you.



**Hard requirement 2: you use AI to do the work**



This is not a bonus point. It's how the job gets done.



We expect you to use Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, or whatever you already like, as your default way of working. Especially on website and sales page updates. Instead of hand-coding a section, you describe it and iterate. Instead of clicking through 40 pages hunting for broken links, you run a script. Instead of eyeballing a mobile layout that broke, you paste the CSS in and ask why.



Real examples of what we mean:



- We hand you a Google Doc of copy. You turn it into a publish-ready GHL funnel page that matches our fonts and colors, using AI to write the HTML and CSS for the custom code blocks.

- A section looks wrong on mobile. You screenshot it, work the CSS out with AI, test it, ship it.

- We change a URL structure. You generate the redirect map instead of writing 60 redirects by hand.

- You need to check every page on the site for broken links and missing images. You write a script once and rerun it monthly.

- A popup needs to fire on exit intent for one traffic source only. You work out the trigger logic with AI rather than waiting on our developer.



You don't need to be a developer. You need to be someone who reaches for AI first, reads what it gives you, tests it, and fixes it when it's wrong. If your answer to "can you build this page section" is "I'd need a developer," this isn't the role.



To be clear about one thing: we want you using AI on the work. We don't want AI pretending to be you. More on that in the application.



Apply at this link: 



**What you'll do**



Core responsibilities:



1.
 and SMS campaign setup. Build, schedule, and update sequences in GoHighLevel. Swap dates, links, and copy before launches.

2. Website and sales page updates, AI-assisted. Website edits, GHL funnel and checkout pages, redirects, broken links and images, popups, and publishing new pages from content we provide. You'll use AI to write and fix the HTML and CSS rather than waiting on a developer or clicking through a page builder for 3 hours.

3. AI bot changes. Adjust prompts and flows on our GHL conversation bots and voice agent when they need tuning.

4. Automation library updates. Document new workflows and keep our internal library current.

5. Automation QA and monitoring. Test workflows end to end, run recurring checks, and investigate when something fires wrong or doesn't fire at all.

6. GHL
 deliverability. Domain health, SPF and DKIM, spam placement investigations, list hygiene.

7. Small scripts and automations. Use Claude Code or a similar tool to build the thing that saves you 2 hours next month.



You'll also pitch in on:



1. CRM and data hygiene in GHL: tags, smartlists, custom fields, duplicate and spam contact cleanup.

2. Google Sheets maintenance: formula fixes, mapping GHL data to trackers, backups.

3. Checkout and product plumbing: creating and cloning GHL and Thinkific checkout pages, basic Stripe product edits, price changes.

4. First-line tech triage: "the site is down," "a student can't log in," "why did she get this
." Diagnose, fix, or escalate.

5. Owning projects end to end. Sometimes we'll hand you a whole project, not a task list. You scope it, break it down, manage your own deadlines, and keep us posted without being chased.



**Tools we use**



You must be strong in GoHighLevel, and you must already work with AI daily.



Basic HTML and CSS helps a lot here. You don't need to write it fro
mory. You need to be able to read what AI hands you, spot what's wrong, and fix it.



You should be comfortable with, or able to pick up quickly: WordPress, Zapier, 
, Thinkific, Stripe, and Google Sheets. We also touch ManyChat, Typeform, Calendly, Slack, and Asana.



Apply at this link: 



**Who does well in this role**



1. You debug before you escalate. When an automation misfires, your first instinct is to open the workflow and trace it, not to ask what to do.

2. You test your own work. Every link clicked, every workflow run end to end, before you mark a task done.

3. You write clearly and fast in English. We work async through Asana and Slack, so your writing is how we know you.

4. You're organized enough to handle 10 to 20 small tasks a week without dropping any.

5. You can project manage yourself. Hand you a project and you come back with a plan, then updates, then a finished result.

6. You reach for AI before you reach for us. When a page section needs building or a layout breaks, your first move is to work it out with AI, not to send a question and wait 12 hours for an answer.

7. You don't trust AI blindly. You check the output, click the links, and load the page on your phone before you say it's done.



**Details**



1. 10 hours per week to start, with room to grow if it's a fit

2. $450 to $650 USD per month, depending on experience

3. Fully remote and async-first, but you need at least 3 working hours between 10pm and 4am Philippine Time so you're available for meetings

4. **Hubstaff time tracking is required.** You track your hours in Hubstaff while you work. This is not optional and it's not negotiable. If you're not willing to track time, stop reading here.

5. Paid every 2 weeks based on tracked Hubstaff hours

6. Independent contractor role

7. Long-term. We're not looking for a 3-month project.



**How to apply**



Apply at this link: 



The form takes about 10 minutes and ends with a short video. Yes, a video is required. It's a 3 minute recording of you talking about your GHL and AI work, with your screen shared. No video, no interview. That's the whole filter.



One note, since we're asking for two things that sound opposite. Use AI on the job as much as you want, that's the point of the role. Don't use it to answer for you in the application. We want to hear you talk about work you actually did, in your own words, with your screen up. Polish isn't what we're grading.



If the video is a dealbreaker for you, that's fine, this just isn't your role.

title: Creative Strategist – DTC Meta Ads | Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
We’re a fast-growing international DTC e-commerce brand looking for an experienced Creative Strategist to take ownership of our Meta creative strategy.



We already have graphic designers, static ad designers, and video editors. We’re not looking for another designer or editor.



We’re looking for the person who d
 what we should create, test, and iterate — and why.



Creative is one of the biggest growth dezeengines of our business, and this role will work directly with the founder and creative team.



What You’ll Do:

*Research competitors, Meta Ad Library, customer reviews, surveys, Reddit, trends, and winning DTC brands

*Find new customer pain points, desires, objections, hooks, and blue-ocean angles

*Develop creative concepts for static ads, UGC, native ads, video, advertorials, and long-form ads

*Write hooks, scripts, headlines, copy, and clear creative briefs

*Brief our designers and video editors

*Analyse creative performance using CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR, hook rate, etc.

*Identify why creatives win or lose

*iterate winners and continuously develop new concepts



Who We’re Looking For:



You:

-Have proven experience with DTC/e-commerce Meta ads

-Understand direct-response marketing and consumer psychology

-Are excellent at finding hooks, angles, and creative concepts

-Can turn research and customer insights into ads

-Understand Meta creative performance data

-Can explain why an ad worked

-Write excellent, natural English for the US market

-Use AI tools effectively for research and creative development

-Can think independently instead of simply copying competitors



You do not need to design or edit the ads yourself. We already have a team for execution.



Proof of Results Required:

Please show us at least 3 successful Meta creatives/concepts you personally worked on.



For each, briefly explain:



The product and angle

Your specific role

The creative

Spend

CPA / ROAS

CTR / CPC where available

Revenue or purchases

Screenshots or other proof where possible



Confidential brand information can be anonymised.



We care about performance, not just attractive portfolios.



How to Apply



Start your application with:



“Creative is the growth engine.”



Then send us:



1.Your 3 best-performing creative examples + results

2.A short explanation of how you find new winning angles

3.How you would approach creating the first 10 concepts for a completely new DTC product

4.The DTC brand you currently think has the best Meta creatives and why

5.Your expected monthly salary in USD



Loom:

Please also send a 3–5 minute Loom analysing one DTC Meta ad you think is excellent.



Explain the hook, angle, psychology, why you think it works, and what you would test next.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is a full-time, long-term role with significant room to grow.



We want someone who can eventually own our creative strategy, work closely with the founder, and help us build a system that consistently produces winning creatives.



If you’re obsessed with understanding why people buy and what we should test next, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Accounting & Payroll Specialist — US Trucking Company (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Hours: 40 hrs/week, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (US)

Salary: $200/week to start, with raises based on performance

Job Type: Full-time, long-term



About Us

ECG Freight is a US-based trucking company. We move freight across the country and we run a tight, numbers-driven operation. We are looking for a sharp, dependable accounting VA to take over from a teammate who is moving on. This is a long-term seat, not a short-term gig.



What You'll Own

- Daily and weekly accounting entries (revenue, fuel, maintenance, settlements)

- Driver payroll — calculating pay, deductions, advances, and reimbursements accurately and on time

- Reconciling bank, fuel card, and vendor statements

- Maintaining clean, organized records in QuickBooks and Google Sheets

- Pulling and calculating weekly numbers for the CEO scorecard (revenue per truck, cost per mile, margin)

- Light data analysis — spotting trends, flagging variances, and explaining what the numbers mean (not just reporting them)



Required Skills

- Strong accounting fundamentals (debits/credits, AR/AP, reconciliations)

- Payroll experience — must be confident calculating gross-to-net and handling deductions

- Excellent with numbers — fast, accurate, and never sloppy

- Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (formulas, pivot tables, basic data analysis)

- QuickBooks Online experience (preferred, not required)

- Fluent written English

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and a working backup plan for power/internet outages



Nice to Have

- Prior experience with US trucking, logistics, or freight company accounting

- Familiarity with TMS systems, fuel card portals (TCS, EFS), or factoring



Who You Are

- Detail-obsessed — a $1.00 mistake bothers you until you find it

- Independent — you don't need to be told twice

- Honest — you flag problems instead of hiding them

- Curious — you want to understand WHY a number is what it is, not just record it



How to Apply

- Send a short message telling me (a) your accounting background, (b) any payroll experience, (c) whether you've worked with US companies before (Voice Recording)

- Attach a resume

- In the first line of your message, write the word "FREIGHT" — this is how I know you actually read the post

- Include any sample reports, dashboards, or spreadsheets you've built (optional but a big plus)



Looking to hire fast. Serious applicants only.

title: AI Graphic Designer (ChatGPT & Nano Banana)
description:
GodSounds is looking for an AI Graphic Designer to create beautiful, high-converting marketing graphics using AI image generation tools such as ChatGPT and Nano Banana.



This position is focused on creating static images and carousel ads that we will use for Meta 
 & Instagram) advertising, websites, landing pages, and social media.



We’re not looking for traditional graphic design. We’re looking for someone who knows how to use AI to create professional, on-brand marketing images quickly and consistently.



The most important qualification is having a great eye for design, taste, and branding. We want images that look polished, premium, and natural—not obviously AI-generated.



What You’ll Do



* Create marketing graphics using ChatGPT, Nano Banana, and other AI image tools.

* Design static ads and carousel graphics for Meta advertising.

* Create images promoting our products, services, apps, audiobooks, and Christian resources.

* Generate multiple creative concepts from a single idea.

* Refine AI prompts until the images look clean, professional, and on-brand.

* Organize completed graphics for our marketing team.



Often your assignments will be simple, such as:



“Create 20 marketing images promoting this audiobook.”



or



“Create several carousel concepts promoting this app.”



Your job is to turn those ideas into polished marketing graphics that are ready to test in advertising campaigns.



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has experience using ChatGPT image generation, Nano Banana, or similar AI image tools.

* Has excellent visual taste and knows what makes a graphic look premium.

* Can recognize when an AI image looks unrealistic or low quality and improve it.

* Understands branding and consistency.

* Can follow creative direction while also bringing fresh ideas.

* Is organized and communicates well.

* Wants to build a long-term working relationship.



Experience with Meta advertising creatives is a bonus but not required.



Hours



Initially this position will be:



* A few hours each week



As our marketing grows, this can expand into:



* 10+ hours per week



We are looking for someone interested in growing with our company long term.



Pay



Our current budget is:



* $3-$8 USD per hour, depending on experience, quality, speed, and creativity.



Trial Project



Please visit both of our websites:



GodSounds







PneumaBreath







After looking through both websites, create several marketing graphics that demonstrate your creativity.



Ideas include:



* Static Meta ad graphics

* Carousel ads

* Promotional images for an audiobook

* Promotional graphics for the PneumaBreath app

* Graphics highlighting free resources

* Brand awareness graphics

* Any additional creative ideas you think would perform well as ads



We are intentionally giving you creative freedom because we want to see your design style, prompt-writing ability, and overall eye for marketing.



Please submit your work in a Google Drive folder or another easy-to-view format.



When You Apply



Please include:



* A short introduction about yourself.

* Your hourly rate.

* Approximately how many hours you can work each week.

* Your test graphics based on the GodSounds and PneumaBreath websites



You can also look up GodSounds to learn more about our company and our mission.



If this position is a good fit, we expect it to become a long-term role as we continue growing our marketing efforts.

description:
Customer Experience & Operations Specialist

US-based personal care brand



Please be sure to read this entire job description before applying.



Location: Remote (Philippines) Type: Full-time Hours: [__] hours/week, with at least [4] hours of daily overlap with US [Mountain/Pacific] time Compensation: [PHP __ – __ per month, depending on experience] + performance bonus Reports to: [Name / Founder]



About us



We are a US-based, fragrance-forward personal care brand — body wash, shampoo, conditioner, deodorant, and soon a safety razor. We sell direct-to-consumer through our Shopify store and on Amazon. We are small, we move fast, and we care enormously about the details: the scent, the packaging, the way an
 reads.



We are currently relaunching the brand with an entirely new fragrance line developed in partnership with one of the world's leading fragrance houses. This role sits right at the front of that relaunch.



We will share full details about the company with candidates we move forward with.



The role in one sentence



You are the voice of our brand to our customers, and the hands that keep product moving behind the scenes.



Most brands treat support as a cost center — a queue of tickets to close as quickly as possible. We don't. Every conversation is a chance to teach someone about our scents, solve a real problem, and turn a first-time buyer into someone who reorders for years and tells their friends. If you close a ticket without leaving the customer feeling better about the brand than before they wrote in, that ticket wasn't finished.



You will own this across three surfaces: our Shopify store, our social channels, and Amazon.



The second half of the role is inventory operations. You will place production and fulfillment orders with our third-party logistics partner and keep our Amazon warehouses stocked. It is unglamorous, it is detail-heavy, and getting it wrong costs us real money — a stockout on Amazon can take weeks to recover from. We need someone who treats it with the same care they bring to a customer
.



What you'll do

Own the conversation

Respond to customer inquiries across Gorgias 
, chat, SMS) with speed and genuine care

Manage Instagram DMs and comments — questions, complaints, compliments, and everything in between

Reply to every Amazon review and customer message in Seller Central, positive and negative alike

Handle order issues, shipping problems, returns, and refunds cleanly and without drama

Build the automations

Build, maintain, and continuously improve Gorgias macros, rules, views, and auto-responses

Build and optimize ManyChat flows for Instagram — comment triggers, DM automations, story replies

Identify the repeat questions and automate them, so human attention goes where it actually matters

Know when an automation is failing a customer, and step in personally before they get frustrated

Sell through service

Recommend products and scents based on what the customer actually needs

Recover abandoned carts and convert pre-purchase questions into orders

Spot upsell and cross-sell moments that genuinely help the customer, and take them

Turn unhappy customers into repeat customers

Protect the voice

Use Claude (or similar AI tools) to draft, refine, and scale responses that sound like us — never generic, never robotic

Learn to write and adjust prompts that reliably reproduce our brand voice

Know our fragrances and formulations well enough to answer real questions about them: what a scent smells like, how it behaves on skin, which product suits which hair type

Keep product moving

Place orders with our 3PL and track them through to completion

Create and manage Amazon FBA shipments — shipping plans, box content, labeling, carrier booking, appointment scheduling

Monitor inventory levels across Shopify, the 3PL, and Amazon, and reorder before we run out

Track inbound shipments and chase down anything delayed, lost, or received short

Watch Amazon's restock limits, IPI score, and storage fees, and plan shipments around them

Maintain a clear, current inventory record the founder can look at any time

Flag low stock early and loudly. A stockout is a failure, not a surprise.



You will take this over from Karen, who currently handles it. She will train you through a full handover period.



Close the loop

Report recurring complaints, product issues, customer language, and inventory position back to the founder weekly

Flag patterns worth acting on — packaging problems, confusing product pages, scent feedback

Track your own numbers and know how you're doing

What we're looking for

Required

2+ years in ecommerce customer service, ideally for a DTC brand

Hands-on Gorgias experience — not just answering tickets, but building macros, rules, and automations

ManyChat experience — you have built working Instagram DM and comment flows yourself

Amazon Seller Central familiarity — comfortable in the back end, responding to reviews and buyer messages

Exceptional written English. Warm, clear, natural, and correctly punctuated. This is the single most important requirement in this listing.

Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) as part of a daily workflow, with real judgment about when to use them and when not to

Amazon FBA shipment experience — you have personally created shipping plans, managed box content, and booked inbound shipments

Experience coordinating with a 3PL — placing orders, chasing delays, reconciling what was received against what was sent

Comfort with spreadsheets and inventory tracking. You are the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up.

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet place to work

Nice to have

Shopify admin experience

Background in beauty, personal care, or fragrance

Klaviyo or
 marketing exposure

Experience with Amazon restock limits, IPI scores, or storage fee planning

Inventory forecasting experience

Experience with a brand going through a rebrand or relaunch

Who thrives here

You genuinely like people, and it shows in how you write

You notice details and they bother you when they're wrong

You would rather fix the cause of ten tickets than answer ten tickets

You can switch between warm customer conversations and precise operational detail without dropping either

You can work independently and make sensible judgment calls without waiting to be told

You care about a brand feeling like a real thing made by real people



One more thing: we read carefully, and we hire people who do the same. Please put "Customer Delight" in the subject line of your application so we know you read this job description all the way through.



How we'll measure success

Metric Target

First response time Under [2] hours during working hours

Resolution time Under [24] hours

Customer satisfaction (CSAT) [90]%+

Amazon review response rate 100%

Revenue attributed to customer conversations Tracked and growing

Tickets deflected by automation Growing quarter over quarter

Amazon stockouts Zero

Inventory record accuracy Current and correct at all times

Inbound shipment issues Caught and escalated before they affect availability

How to apply



Please send:



A short note — a few paragraphs, not a form letter — telling us about a time you turned an unhappy customer into a happy one. What did you say, and why did it work?

Your CV

Screenshots or a short screen recording of a Gorgias setup or ManyChat flow you personally built, and — if you have it — an Amazon FBA shipping plan you created

A short exercise:



A customer writes in, annoyed. She bought our body wash three weeks ago, loved the scent, and just reordered — but the new bottle smells noticeably different to her. She wants to know if we changed the formula, and she's frustrated because it was her favorite.



Write the reply you would send. Then, in two or three sentences, explain what you were trying to accomplish with it.

title: AI Video Generator + Editor
description:
ASSIGNMENT FOR THE JOB. PLEASE REVIEW THE JOB DESCRIPTION AND IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT PLEASE COMPLETE THIS SHORT RECREATION ASSIGNMENT. 



Use the reference photo: 



And recreate this video using our character from the reference above: 
==



Ensure the frames all look very similar but make sure you adjust the background, dog and man to fit our character. Also slightly change the script to fit huskies rather than pit bulls. 



THIS ASSIGNMENT IS A MAJOR FACTOR IN THE HIRING PROCESS



JOB DESCRIPTION:



About the role

- Our team is looking to hire a new video editor! We produce short-form AI-generated video content, generated imagery, generated footage, and cloned voice, cut into finished pieces for social. This role owns that pipeline end to end: you generate the stills, animate them, clone and direct the voice, and cut the final edit.



- This is a maker role, not a strategy role. You won't be staring at a blank page.



- You'll be given a script and reference videos for every piece, so the creative direction is already set. Your job is to execute it well and fast. Volume and consistency matter more than any single hero video. If you like sitting in the generation loop, rejecting 90% of what comes out, and finding the 10% that actually looks real, this is your job.



What you'll be doing

Image generation

- Build the keyframes every video starts from, we generate stills first, fix them until they're genuinely convincing, then animate. No text-to-video shortcuts.

- Maintain character and identity consistency across scenes, angles, and lighting setups using reference images and trained identity models.

- Prompt with intent: match a specific key light, color palette, lens feel, and wardrobe rather than accepting whatever the model defaults to.



Video generation

- Animate approved keyframes in Google Flow, image-to-video, reference-driven generation, scene extension, camera motion.

- Work in short takes. Identity holds for roughly 5 seconds and drifts after, so the job is cutting more and generating less.

- Run and log iterations efficiently: know when a prompt is one nudge from working and when to throw it out and re-shoot the keyframe.



Voice

- Build and maintain voice clones in ElevenLabs, and manage the source recordings that feed them. (VOICE CLONES FOR ALL CHARACTERS WILL BE PROVIDED)

- Direct delivery pacing, emphasis, emotion — and regenerate until a line reads naturally instead of like narration.

- Clean up audio, match lip and body timing to the visuals, and keep voice consistent across an entire series.



Editing & finishing

- Cut everything together in CapCut: pacing, hooks, transitions, captions, sound design, music beds.

- Color and grade-match clips from different generations so a sequence reads as one continuous piece.

- Export and upload to google drive for review



Scripting & workflow

- All scripts and reference videos will be provided daily so you don't have to stress about what to create

- If accepted into this job you will be provided access to a tool that improves your workflow and speed drastically (this means you make more $$)



Quality control

- Catch what breaks the illusion before we publish: identity drift, over-smoothed skin, mismatched light direction, hand and face artifacts, warped background detail.

- Flag anything that creates a rights, likeness, or platform-policy problem.



What you'll be working from

- You get direction daily, this is not a role where you're left guessing what to make.

- Scripts are written and provided for you. You may refine wording for pacing or delivery, but you're not starting from scratch.

- Reference videos are provided for every piece, showing the look, pacing, tone, and structure we're going for. Your job is to hit that reference, then improve on it where you can.

- Feedback and revisions come regularly. Expect notes, and expect to turn them around quickly.



IMPORTANT: Coming in, you should be able to watch a reference video and break it down yourself, how many shots, what the camera is doing, where the cuts land, how the audio is built.



Tools we provide (if needed):

Google Flow — video generation

ElevenLabs — voice cloning and generation

Claude — scripting, prompt development, workflow acceleration

CapCut — editing and finishing

[Workflow tool] — pipeline, asset management, and automation



You don't need to have used all five. You do need to be the kind of person who gets fluent in a new tool in a weekend.



What we're looking for

- A portfolio or reel of AI-generated video work, this matters more than a résumé. Show us the finished pieces, and if you can, show us what the raw generations looked like first.

- Real prompt craft, especially for character consistency. Anyone can get one good image; we need the same face across forty of them.

- Solid editing instincts, pacing, timing, sound, and an eye for when a cut is one frame too long.

- An eye for light and continuity. Most AI video looks fake because the lighting doesn't match, not because the model is bad.

- Tolerance for iteration. Most of what you generate gets deleted. That's the job, not a sign it's going badly.

- Organized and self-directed. You'll be given a brief and a deadline, not step-by-step direction.

MOST IMPORTANT: Maintaining consistency and realism in the videos



How to apply



- Send your recreation assignment along with your portfolio

- The recreation assignment is a large factor, it determines your ability to work with us!



I look forward to personally reviewing all your submissions!

ABOUT THE ROLE



Contact Marketers LLC is seeking an experienced Senior Recruiter to support our Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) clients.



This is a hands-on recruiting and headhunting position—not a people-management role. You will not have direct reports.



We need someone who knows how to proactively find great candidates, including passive candidates who aren't actively applying for jobs. You will personally manage searches from initial client intake and candidate sourcing through interviews, offers, and successful placement.



If you are a recruiter who enjoys hunting for talent, building candidate pipelines, and filling difficult positions, we want to hear from you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Maintain accurate candidate and recruiting activity in the ATS/CRM.



• Take ownership of each search from intake through successful placement.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• 3–5+ years of professional recruiting or talent acquisition experience.



• Strong full-cycle recruiting experience.



• Demonstrated success sourcing and headhunting passive candidates.



• Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, resume databases, job boards, Boolean search, and direct candidate outreach.



• Experience conducting candidate screens and interviews.



• Experience managing multiple job requisitions simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.



• Excellent organization, follow-up, and candidate-management skills.



• Experience using ATS and recruiting CRM platforms.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), staffing agencies, executive search, direct-hire recruiting, agency recruiting, corporate talent acquisition, or difficult-to-fill professional positions is strongly preferred.  We offer monthly performance bonuses.  



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE?



You're a recruiter and headhunter first.

"Where should I post this job?"



It's:

Contact Marketers LLC provides specialized staffing and Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) solutions to businesses that need experienced recruiting support.



Our RPO team helps clients keep their candidate pipelines full and their hiring processes moving—from candidate sourcing and screening through interviews, background checks, offers, and hiring.

description:

title: Remote Bookkeeper + Customer Support Specialist
description:
We're a growing flower business looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper who genuinely enjoys making numbers tie out to the penny. You'll own the daily financial pulse of the business — tracking every sale across Shopify, cash, and Zelle, reconciling team logs against actual payments, and catching discrepancies before they become problems.



This is not a passive data-entry role. We need someone who notices when something doesn't add up and digs until they find out why.



What You'll Do

Daily (the core of the job):

*Record all sales across Shopify, cash, and Zelle in QuickBooks

*Reconcile the team's daily sales logs against actual payments received

*Track inventory movement (incoming, sold, remaining, wastage)

*Flag discrepancies, missing items, or anything that looks off

*Submit a daily report summarizing sales, cash position, and any variances



Weekly:

*Maintain Excel reports for sales, inventory, and cash trends

*Prepare a weekly summary report for the owner

Reconcile bank activity and payment processor payouts



As needed:

*Respond to customer messages when the team is tied up

*Support the owner with light admin tasks tied to financial operations



What We're Looking For

Required:

*Real QuickBooks experience (you can explain the difference between a sales receipt and an invoice without thinking)

*Strong Excel skills — pivot tables, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and you build formulas, not just formatted tables

*Multi-channel sales reconciliation experience (ideally Shopify + cash + a digital payment app like Zelle, PayPal, GCash, etc.)

*Honest, calm, and methodical — you document your work and aren't defensive when asked to explain it

*Clear English communication, written and spoken

*Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the daily report



Bonus points for:

*Retail or perishable inventory experience

*Bookkeeping for a US-based small business

*Experience reconciling Shopify payouts (you know payout timing and fee handling)



What This Job Is Not

*It's not a place to learn QuickBooks from scratch — we need someone who already works in it daily.

*It's not a 9-to-5 with someone watching over you. You'll work independently, which means missed reports are immediately visible.

*It's not a stepping stone — we want someone who'll grow with us for at least 18–24 months. Bonuses and pay increases are tied to performance and tenure.



How to Apply

Send the following to 

1. A 1–2 minute voice recording answering this question: "Walk me through how you would handle this situation — at the end of the day, the team's sales log shows $1,847 in cash sales, but the cash drawer only has $1,790. What do you do?"

2. A sample of your bookkeeping or Excel work — a sanitized reconciliation, sales report, or inventory tracker you've actually built. Screenshots or files are fine. Templates downloaded from the internet don't count.

3. A short note with:

*Your years of QuickBooks experience

*Your current timezone and weekly hours of availability

*One sentence on why this role fits you right now



Applications missing any of these three items will not be reviewed. We're serious about detail — the application itself is the first test.

title: B2B Growth Marketer & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Job Title: B2B Growth Marketer & Lead Gen Specialist (Not an Admin Role!)



The Company:

Porameta is launching as Portugal’s first premium, Agent-Exclusive Commercial Real Estate Marketplace. We are a fast-moving, agile team split between Porto, Portugal, and Manila, Philippines. We are gearing up for a massive public launch on June 15th, and we need a heavy-hitting digital marketer to build our engine.



The Mission 

Before we open our doors to global investors, we need to populate our marketplace with premium commercial properties. Your mission is purely B2B (Business-to-Business): You must build automated systems to acquire, contact, and convert Portuguese real estate agents, convincing them to upload their properties to our platform before launch day.



 Please Read Before Applying

This is NOT a general Virtual Assistant, Admin, or Organic Social Media role. If your primary skills are calendar management, creating Canva graphics, or writing basic
 posts, please do not apply. We are looking for a highly technical Growth Marketer.



What You Will Actually Do:



B2B Data Scraping & Harvesting: Build pristine, highly targeted lists of independent real estate agents in Portugal using scraping tools (PhantomBuster, Apollo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.).



WhatsApp API & Outbound Automation: We don't use standard cold
; European agents live on WhatsApp. You will set up, manage, and scale automated B2B outreach campaigns using the WhatsApp Business API (via tools like 
, WATI, or GoHighLevel).



Paid B2B Acquisition: Launch and manage highly targeted Meta 
/IG) and LinkedIn Ad campaigns aimed strictly at commercial brokers in Lisbon, Porto, and the Algarve. You will own the ROAS and CPC metrics.



CRM & Funnel Management: Build the lead-routing system so when an agent replies to our automated messages, the warm lead is instantly routed to our local Director in Portugal to close the deal.



The Skills You Must Have:



Proven experience building scalable B2B Lead Generation funnels from scratch.



Deep understanding of Paid Ads (Meta Ads Manager & LinkedIn Campaign Manager).



Experience integrating APIs, CRMs (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, etc.), and messaging platforms.



A highly analytical mindset. You love A/B testing copy, optimizing conversion rates, and making decisions based on data, not guesses.



Perfect written English. (Our local team will handle the Portuguese translations, but you must be able to communicate strategy flawlessly).



Why Work With Us?

You won't be micromanaged doing repetitive tasks. You are being hired to be the architect of our digital growth engine. You will work directly with the Global Project Director and the local team in Europe to launch a platform that disrupts the Portuguese commercial real estate market.



How to Apply:

To prove you have the high attention to detail required for this role, please begin your cover letter/message with the exact phrase: "I am ready to launch Porameta." Applications without this phrase will be instantly deleted. In your application, please include a 2-3 sentence description of a specific B2B outbound campaign or Paid Ad funnel you successfully built in the past.
